name: iApp
description_plain: A new employee has been granted access to our Makarpura site; however, when attempting to punch in, the machine displays an "Authorization Failed" message. Please investigate this issue. Name - Jignesh Patel SAP ID - 392764
comments:
Hi Zeel,

Please find the attached data as requested.
solution:
As per today’s meeting, we updated the latest shared firmware.

After the update, we checked Mr. Jignesh Patel’s punch data and encountered the error: **EmpID Int.Fail - Card Not Properly Read in iApp**.

To resolve this, we surrendered Mr. Jignesh Patel’s card and assigned a new one. After this change, Mr. Patel was able to successfully punch in on the machine.

We then surrendered the newly assigned card, reassigned the old card to Mr. Patel, and re-read the card in iApp. Once access was granted, Mr. Patel was able to punch in with his old card as well.

There is no issue with the card or software; the issue occurred because the card was not properly read.

name: iApp
description_plain: I am unable to apply overtime due to the overtime option is not showing. Employee Name- Prabhakar Shukla Emp. Code- 108611 I think overtime policy is not updated. Kindly note that person today come in the evening shift so, rectify the issues on urgent basis.
comments:
1. The client reported that when they tried to apply overtime for employee ID 108611 on the date 02/12/2024, it showed "no overtime calculated" for that day.  
2. I opened the attendance sheet and attempted to apply overtime, but the application page did not open and showed an error.  
3. I went to the overtime/COFF application page, added a new application, filled in all the details, and saved the information, but the same error occurred. After checking, I found that according to the employee's overtime policy, only pre-overtime applications are applicable. The application for overtime must be submitted before the last punch on the attendance date; otherwise, the application is not valid for that employee.
solution:
1. The client reported that when they tried to apply overtime for employee ID 108611 on the date 02/12/2024, it showed "no overtime calculated" for that day.  
2. I opened the attendance sheet and attempted to apply overtime, but the application page did not open and showed an error.  
3. I went to the overtime/COFF application page, added a new application, filled in all the details, and saved the information, but the same error occurred. After checking, I found that according to the employee's overtime policy, only pre-overtime applications are applicable. The application for overtime must be submitted before the last punch on the attendance date; otherwise, the application is not valid for that employee.

description_plain: Unable to view attendance in ESS Application.
comments:
During our remote session, we noticed that one user was marked as 'Absent' even though they claimed to have submitted their 'Start Day/End Day' in the ESS application. After troubleshooting, we found that the user had not ended their day from 02-12-2024 to 10-12-2024, which is why their attendance was not reflected.

To resolve this, we first enabled the 'Backdated Application Beyond _ Days' option and bypassed the description in the Attendance Policy under Remote Work, allowing us to end the day even for backdated entries. We then guided the user to end their day at the close of each workday and instructed them to manually "End Day" for the period 02-12-2024 to 10-12-2024.

description_plain: Hod only device not working so need to replace the device.
comments:
1. The client needed to replace the device because the old one was not working. First, I guided them to enter the IP address, subnet mask, and gateway into the device.  
2. After that, the device's IP was successfully pinged from the server, so I opened the bootloader application and configured the device parameters.  
3. I updated the firmware of the device, then went to the software and added the new device, saving the device parameters successfully.  
4. I went to the card format settings, set the card format for the device, and performed a factory reset.  
5. I went to the access groups menu, added the device to the old access group, and added the device to the attendance settings.  
6. I started the user dump process on the device, but the machine command was showing as pending in the database and seemed stuck.  
7. I discussed this case with Setul Sir, deleted the machine command, and restarted the Spectra Worker service.  
8. I repeated the same process multiple times, also waiting for some time for the machine data to clear, but it still didn't clear.  
9. I checked and found that the canteen port was inserted incorrectly in another device, which caused all the device commands to be stuck. I updated the correct port and then started the Spectra Worker service.  
10. I restarted the user dump process, waited for some time, and after the process was completed, the device started working fine.
solution: As per the client's confirmation, the device is working fine now.

11. I App > Setting > User Administration > Users > Add User Group > Select Security Monitor Role > Select Company > Select Location > Select Created Access Group > Save. 
12.I App > Setting > User Administration > Users > Select User Group > Edit > Add user > Save.

Done the setup for 2 locations.

As per discussed with team and provided points to client:



1) If an employee's punch data appears in the attendance sheet, the employee cannot be resigned or relieved on the same date. Resignation or relief can only be processed starting from the next date. (This is a standard functionality.)

case closed.

name: iApp
ticket_title: Punch data is not reflecting in third party table
description_plain: Punch data is not reflecting in third party table
comments:
We found in the system that four third-party configurations have been set up to provide attendance data to Grey HR, as per your earlier requirement.

Three separate third-party configurations are in place for the Bangalore, Delhi, and Mumbai locations, which transfer data to the same table, Attendance_Report, from where Grey HR retrieves the attendance data.

The fourth configuration includes all three locations and transfers data to the Third_Party table.

As you mentioned, you have provided global access rights to all employees, such that, for example, a Bangalore employee can punch in at the Mumbai or Delhi location, and this attendance data should transfer to Grey HR.

Currently, you're facing an issue where, if an employee punches in at a Bangalore device, the attendance data shows up in Grey HR, but if the employee punches in at another location, the data does not appear in Grey HR.

This issue occurs because, during the configuration of the third-party table, we need to select the devices by location from which data will transfer to the third-party table. Additionally, we must define the location column in the third-party table.

In the Attendance_Report table (from where Grey HR retrieves the data), the location column is not configured, so this table is only receiving data from the selected location. Attendance data from other locations is being transferred to the Third_Party table.

In conclusion, the data is split, which is causing the issue you're facing.

To resolve this, we need to use only one third-party configuration that can capture data from all locations.

As discussed, please review this internally and let us know so we can proceed further.
solution: We recovered data from back end

name: iApp
description_plain: Need to biomini install in my system on urgent basis, a
comments:
1. The client reported that they need to install the BioMini fingerprint access setup on an urgent basis.  
2. I discussed it with their IT team, and since the BioMini setup is not available, I need to send it to them.  
3. Due to restrictions, I am only able to share a OneDrive link, so I logged into my OneDrive, uploaded the BioMini setup, created the link, and shared it with the client.
solution:
1. The client reported that they need to set up BioMini fingerprint access on a new system and purchase a new BioMini device.  
2. I requested remote access from them and asked them to wait for some time while I waited for the remote access.  
3. The setup was downloaded on the system, and after receiving remote access, I found that the Spectra client service was already listed in the services. However, when I tried to check in the control panel, it was not showing.  
4. I then requested them to remove the service. After they removed it and restarted the system, I waited for some time, and once the system was restarted, I began the BioMini installation process.  
5. First, I installed the Spectra client service, and then I installed the BioMini Suprema drivers.  
6. I copied all the Spectra client folder files to the C drive and gave full access rights to the folder for everyone.  
7. I copied all the files to the System32 and SysWow64 folders and installed two libraries.  
8. After that, I started the Spectra client service and guided the client to log in to the software. I instructed them to take the employee’s fingerprint, and it was successfully captured in the system.  
9. I also guided them to assign access to the employee, and the access is working fine.

description_plain: Still unable to provide access to new employee / CW. Screenshot is also attached for your reference.
comments:
1. The client reported that when trying to grant canteen access to an employee, the page shows a loading screen. After 1-2 minutes, the command status page opens, and after an additional 5 minutes, the device command is sent to only one employee.
2. The client showed me the issue in a Teams meeting, and I joined the session. He demonstrated the live example, which was correct, and I found that the access command was taking a long time to execute on the device.
3. I discussed this case with Setul Sir, and then I accessed the Zydus server, opened the database, and executed the following query:
   `Select * from machinedata where commandstatus='P'`
4. I found over 2 lakh entries marked as pending, so I removed the unwanted duplicate entries from the machine data.
5. After that, I restarted the Spectra worker services and waited for some time to clear all the entries.
6. Now, the access command is working properly and smoothly.

name: iApp
description_plain: Devices showing inactive that's why attendance is not showing.
comments:
1. The client reported that five attendance devices have been showing as inactive since 09/12/2024, which is why the attendance data is not displaying.  
2. The client shared a Teams meeting with me, where I joined Mr. Jignesh Prajapati. Afterward, the IT team confirmed that all the device IPs are working fine and showing as active in the local system.  
3. I accessed the Zydus server, first checked the IP pings, and found that all the device IPs were working fine and showing as active.  
4. After that, I opened the bootloader application, and the devices were visible. I cross-checked the device parameters with the active devices shown in the software and found that the subnet mask and gateway were incorrectly configured by the client.  
5. I explained to them that both device parameters were wrong, which is why all the devices were showing as inactive in the Zydus server.  
6. I corrected the device parameters using the bootloader application, then refreshed the database page in the software, and now all the devices are showing as active.  
7. I requested the client to please wait for some time to allow all the pending transactions to clear from the devices.

name: iApp
description_plain: This morning, we noticed that someone changed the biometric device server IP address. The current IP address reverted to the old server IP, causing all devices to go offline, as shown in the screenshot below. Please note that Security SOP 2350-SOP-SC-00003 is obsolete, and the current SOP 2350-SOP-ENG-00121 is now effective. Kindly take the necessary steps to identify who made this change.
comments:
1. The client reported that the IP address of 50+ devices changed, causing all the devices to show as inactive in the software.
2. I accessed the database menu and found that all the devices were showing as inactive.
3. I checked the Zydus server by pinging the device IPs and found that the devices were active, so I opened the bootloader application and searched for the devices. I found that the server IP and server port were incorrect for all 50+ devices.
4. I updated the server IP and server port in all the devices one by one, and after that, the devices showed as active in the software.
5. Two devices were still showing as offline, so I found that the IPs of both devices were not pinging on the server. After discussing with the IT team, we identified a network issue, which was then resolved.
solution:
1. The client reported that the IP address of 50+ devices changed, causing all the devices to show as inactive in the software.
2. I accessed the database menu and found that all the devices were showing as inactive.
3. I checked the Zydus server by pinging the device IPs and found that the devices were active, so I opened the bootloader application and searched for the devices. I found that the server IP and server port were incorrect for all 50+ devices.
4. I updated the server IP and server port in all the devices one by one, and after that, the devices showed as active in the software.
5. Two devices were still showing as offline, so I found that the IPs of both devices were not pinging on the server. After discussing with the IT team, we identified a network issue, which was then resolved.

description_plain: Please clear showing visitor pass duplicate entry in liva location.
comments:
1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 200 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID. 
2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from Sept. 1, 2024, to Dec, 2024, and found more than 500 duplicate entries for all Zydus locations. 
3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: 
Select * into Visitor_18122024 from Visitor 
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: 
Select * from Location 
Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='22' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: 
Delete from Visitor where id='666167' 
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.

description_plain: It has been observed that since yesterday evening, the iAPP has been working very slowly. Our Time Attendance team is unable to perform their tasks effectively due to this issue. Please check and resolve the issue as soon as possible.
comments:
1. The client reported that the IAPP is working too slowly and it is taking a long time to reflect the page.
2. I opened the IAPP and found that it was working slowly. When I clicked on any module, it took too much time to open the page.
3. I checked the Zydus server, and it was not responding properly due to a server hang issue.
4. After that, I opened the Task Manager and found that CPU consumption was high, showing 98%, which is why the software was not working properly.
5. I found that "dcpatchscan.exe" was consuming high CPU, so I connected with the Zydus HO IT team and discussed the need to end the process for this exe and remove it from the Task Manager.
6. I stopped the Spectra worker process and IIS server, waited for some time, and then restarted both processes.
7. Now, the CPU consumption is normal, so I executed the following query in the database:
   ```sql
   SELECT r.cpu_time AS cpu, s.login_name,
   DATEDIFF(SECOND, last_request_start_time, getdate()) AS Seconds,
   s.session_id AS SessionID, blocking_session_id AS Blocking,
   SUBSTRING(st.text, (statement_start_offset/2)+1,
             ABS(((CASE statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text)
             ELSE statement_end_offset
             END - statement_start_offset)/2) + 1 )) AS statement_text,
   OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(objectid, r.database_id) AS SchemaName
   FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
   INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id
   CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(sql_handle) AS st
   ORDER BY Seconds DESC
   ```
8. I found two or three services showing high CPU usage, so I killed those processes in the database.
9. I also removed unwanted data from the C drive to manage the drive space. The IAPP software is working fine now.

name: iApp
description_plain: We need to install the BioMini finger access system to capture the fingerprints of the employees.
comments:
1. The client needs to install BioMini on one system, so I discussed with the IT team to check if the BioMini setup is available. The IT team found the BioMini setup.
2. After that, I requested remote access to proceed with the installation activity.
3. I received the Teams link for remote access after some time, connected, and when I tried to install the Spectra client service, it prompted for the admin ID and password. I then requested the IT team to please log in with the admin credentials.
4. The IT team worked on it and connected with me once the admin login was received.
solution:
1. The client reported that they need to set up BioMini fingerprint access on a new system and purchase a new BioMini device. 
2. I requested remote access from them and asked them to wait for some time while I waited for the remote access. 
3. The setup was downloaded on the system, and after receiving remote access, I found that the Spectra client service was already listed in the services. However, when I tried to check in the control panel, it was not showing. 
4. I then requested them to remove the service. After they removed it and restarted the system, I waited for some time, and once the system was restarted, I began the BioMini installation process. 
5. First, I installed the Spectra client service, and then I installed the BioMini Suprema drivers. 
6. I copied all the Spectra client folder files to the C drive and gave full access rights to the folder for everyone. 
7. I copied all the files to the System32 and SysWow64 folders and installed two libraries. 
8. After that, I started the Spectra client service and guided the client to log in to the software. I instructed them to take the employee’s fingerprint, and it was successfully captured in the system. 
9. I also guided them to assign access to the employee, and the access is working fine.

ticket_title: Bio Metric Report generate and Get finger issue.
description_plain: Hi Team, Recently, we purchased 5 Bio Scribe 2C units and configured them at multiple locations. After adding the users to the biometric system, we generated a report after a week. However, the report is showing blank entries for in/out times and total hours, even though the user punch data is stored in iApp. I have attached a screenshot for your reference. Kindly do the needful. Additionally, one of the biometric displays had a flickering issue, which we sent to the Spectra service center for repair. Last week, we received the serviced biometric device and installed it yesterday. After syncing the users in the biometric system via iApp, the user fingerprints are not showing in both biometrics. Despite our maximum efforts, we could not fetch the user fingerprints. We informed @'Hardware Bangalore' and Mr. Arasappa took a remote session to fix the issue. However, the issue persists, and he advised us to add the users to the biometric system again. Given that we have over 100 users, it's not feasible to add them all again. Therefore, I request you to retrieve the user fingerprints in the iApp. I have attached a screenshot for your review. Kindly do the needful. The issue has been ongoing for more than 15 days and is still not resolved. @Karthik Kannan, your intervention is needed.
comments: we need to update the iAPP version.
solution:
After checking with our internal hardware team, I would like to inform you that the Bioscribe 2C device, by default, only operates in "in" device mode in the access module. When used in "Null" device mode, it behaves similarly, without providing the "out" functionality.

As an alternative solution, the device can be used in the attendance module, where it offers both "in" and "out" modes while in Null device mode, as expected. Alternatively, the device can be operated in toggle mode within the access module to achieve the desired functionality.

Currently, there is no direct way to modify this behavior in the access module, but please be assured that our team is actively working on a solution to address this limitation.

description_plain: The issue with iAPP remains unresolved, and its performance continues to be very slow. Please provide an update as soon as possible. If the issue cannot be resolved today, kindly assign someone from your team to address it tomorrow.
comments:
1. The client reported that the IAPP is working very slowly, taking 5-10 minutes to open the software.
2. I opened the IAPP and confirmed that it was running very slowly, so I accessed the Zydus server.
3. I found that the server was not responding properly, so I opened the Task Manager and discovered that CPU utilization was at 95%, which was causing the slow performance.
4. I stopped the Spectra Worker service and the IIS server, then waited for some time.
5. Afterward, I restarted both the IIS server and the Worker process. The IAPP is now functioning properly, and we have taken this case under observation.
solution:
1. The client reported that the IAPP is working too slowly and it is taking a long time for the page to reflect.
2. I opened the IAPP and found that it was working slowly. When I clicked on any module, it took a long time to open the page.
3. I checked the Zydus server, and it was not responding properly due to a server hang issue.
4. After that, I opened the Task Manager and found that CPU consumption was high, showing 98%, which was why the software was not working properly.
5. Since the CPU consumption was high, I executed the following query in the database: 
```sql
SELECT r.cpu_time AS cpu, s.login_name, DATEDIFF(SECOND, last_request_start_time, getdate()) AS Seconds, 
       s.session_id AS SessionID, blocking_session_id AS Blocking, 
       SUBSTRING(st.text, (statement_start_offset/2)+1, 
                 ABS(((CASE statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text) ELSE statement_end_offset END - statement_start_offset)/2) + 1 )) AS statement_text, 
       OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(objectid, r.database_id) AS SchemaName 
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r 
INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id 
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(sql_handle) AS st 
ORDER BY Seconds DESC
```
6. I found two or three services showing high CPU usage, so I killed those processes in the database.
7. I also removed unwanted data from the C drive to manage the drive space, but the same issue persisted.
8. I executed the following query in the database to find the machine header command:
```sql
SELECT * FROM machineheader (NOLOCK) WHERE commandstatus='P'
```
9. I found that a total of 10 commands were executed for the user dump process, which was causing the system to respond slowly.
10. I checked and found that Mr. Rakesh from the Dabhasa location executed this command. I then connected with Jignesh sir to discuss this matter and removed all the commands.
11. After removing the commands, the IAPP started working properly. I also guided them not to execute the user dump command without permission.

name: iApp
description_plain: Attendance data not showing from two days in all over zydus locations.
comments:
1. The client reported that attendance data has not been showing for the past 2 days, and the software is working slowly.  
2. I opened the software, and it was taking a long time to load the page.  
3. I accessed the Zydus server and found that the server was hanging. I opened the Task Manager and saw that CPU utilization was over 95%.  
4. I opened the database and executed the following query:  
   `SELECT * FROM machineheader WHERE commandstatus='P'`  
5. I found that 3 commands were pending for the device user dump process, and there were 5 lakh commands in the queue, which was causing the system to slow down and preventing data from displaying.  
6. I removed the user dump commands from the machineheader and machinedata, then restarted the Spectra worker service. The iApp is now working fine.  
7. After that, I executed the following query:  
   `SELECT * FROM trans WHERE id >= '126092036' ORDER BY punchdetail DESC`  
8. The system is now receiving punches, and I waited for some time to clear all the pending transactions from the device.  
9. After waiting for a while, all the attendance data is now showing properly in the software.
solution:
1. The client reported that attendance data has not been showing for the past 2 days, and the software is working slowly.  
2. I opened the software, and it was taking a long time to load the page.  
3. I accessed the Zydus server and found that the server was hanging. I opened the Task Manager and saw that CPU utilization was over 95%.  
4. I opened the database and executed the following query:  
   `SELECT * FROM machineheader WHERE commandstatus='P'`  
5. I found that 3 commands were pending for the device user dump process, and there were 5 lakh commands in the queue, which was causing the system to slow down and preventing data from displaying.  
6. I removed the user dump commands from the machineheader and machinedata, then restarted the Spectra worker service. The iApp is now working fine.  
7. After that, I executed the following query:  
   `SELECT * FROM trans WHERE id >= '126092036' ORDER BY punchdetail DESC`  
8. The system is now receiving punches, and I waited for some time to clear all the pending transactions from the device.  
9. After waiting for a while, all the attendance data is now showing properly in the software.

name: iApp
description_plain: As per trailing mail, below mentioned Apprentice register in Biologics Location. He is continuously working on our plant since Aug-24 but as of now his status showing block and we are unable to activate again. Plz check & resolve the issue ASAP.
comments:
1. The client reported that when they try to activate the user, an error appears stating that the user is not relieved in the system.  
2. I discussed this case with Setul Sir, then accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query:  
   `SELECT * FROM allusers WHERE empcode='ZBAMP80'`  
3. I found the same ID in both the allusers and employeemaster tables.  
4. I need to discuss more details with the client, so I consulted with Jignesh Sir for further investigation.
solution:
1. I discussed with the client and found that when they try to rejoin the apprentice, an error appears stating that the apprentice is not resigned.
2. I opened the apprentice master, followed the same process, and encountered the same error. The status in the system was showing as "relieved."
3. I discussed this case with Setul Sir and determined that the status needs to be changed in the database.
4. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries:
   - `Select * from apprentice where code='ZBAPP180'`
   - `Select * from allusers(nolock) where id='100750'`
5. I found that the "Inactive" field was showing the status as "resign," so I updated the status to "N" (active).
6. After that, I reopened the software, reprocessed the status, and the apprentice is now showing as active properly.

description_plain: Hi, Kindly configure the below mentioned device. The former mail communications attached for reference.
comments:
1. The client reported that the old turnstile device is not working and is showing a HEX200 error, which is a hardware error, so the device needs to be replaced with a new one.  
2. I first checked the old device and found that it was showing as inactive in the software, so I took the Zydus server.  
3. I found that the device IP was working fine on the server, so I opened the bootloader application and updated the firmware of the device. After that, the device showed as active in the software, but the user, finger, and pending commands were not showing.  
4. I requested the client to remove the old device and install the new device in its place. The client will contact me once the installation of the new device is complete.
solution:
1. After the device installation was completed, I took the Zydus server, pinged the IP, and found that the device IP was showing as active.  
2. I opened the bootloader application and updated the firmware of the device.  
3. I then went to the software, changed the MAC address of the device, saved the device parameters, and the command was successfully executed.  
4. I went to the card format settings, set the card format for the device, and then added the device to the turnstile access group.  
5. After that, I started the user dump activity and waited for some time to complete the process.  
6. Now the process is completed, and the device is working fine.

name: iApp
description_plain: Security 15 login showing error when open it.
comments:
1. The client reported that when they open the Security15 login, an error appears stating "HTTP connection," and the software does not open.  
2. I requested them to share the login credentials so I could check from here as well. After receiving the credentials, I logged into the Security15 login ID.  
3. When I opened the software, the connection error appeared. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query to check for any URL-related issues:  
   - `SELECT * FROM UserMaster(nolock) WHERE empid='145'`  
   - `SELECT * FROM usersettings WHERE category LIKE '%UserDefaultURL%' and id='193'`  
4. I did not find any URL, so I executed the following queries to check if any filtering was applied:  
   - `SELECT * FROM UserMaster(nolock) WHERE empid='8870'`  
   - `SELECT * FROM usersettings WHERE id='27' AND category LIKE '%filter%'`  
   - `DELETE FROM usersettings WHERE category IN ('FILTERING') AND id='27'`  
5. I found that filtering was applied, so I deleted the filtering data and logged in again to the software, but the same issue persisted.  
6. I copied the URL from another login, pasted it into the web browser, and the software opened. Then, I went to the Frontdesk menu in the VMS and removed the incorrect filtering that was applied by the client.

4. I have requested the client to please wait for some time while all the pending transactions are cleared from the device.

name: iApp
description_plain: I would like to bring to your attention regarding attendance and Turnstile reports. Since 23/12/24, after 5:59 PM, no punching data has been reflected in either the attendance reports or Turnstile reports across any plant. As the payroll closing deadline is approaching, it is imperative to resolve this issue promptly to avoid any payment losses for employees. Kindly look into this matter urgently and provide a resolution at the earliest. Your immediate assistance will be highly appreciated. Looking forward to your swift response.
comments:
1. The client reported that attendance data is not showing, so I and our development team, Mr. Prashant is working on it. 
2. Data downloading has started, and Mr. Prashant is doing indexing in all the big tables in SQL for smooth performance. 
3. We are waiting for some time to clear all the pending attendance transactions from the device.
solution: 1. The client reported that attendance punches have not been showing for the last two days, and tomorrow is the payroll processing day. 2. I found that attendance data is missing across all Zydus locations for the past two days. 3. This case was escalated to the development team. The initial issue is that the iApp is working very slowly, preventing users from performing any tasks in the software. 4. I checked the Zydus server and found that CPU utilization was above 95%. 5. I restarted the Spectra worker service and the IIS server, then waited for a while, but the same issue persisted. 6. I then accessed the Zydus database server and attempted to restart the SQL server service, but I did not have the necessary permissions. I contacted the Zydus HO IT team and requested the required rights. 7. After receiving the rights, I restarted the SQL server, but the issue remained. 8. I discussed the situation with Setul Sir and connected with the development team. Mr. Dhaval Patel from the development team joined the troubleshooting process. 9. We discovered that the "Devicetrans" table contained over 8.1 million records, which was consuming excessive space. We decided to delete unnecessary records from the table. 10. Deleting the records took more than 2 hours to complete. 11. Once the records were deleted, I restarted the Spectra worker service, and the punch data began downloading successfully and at an improved speed. 12. The iApp software is now working properly. I am waiting for all pending transactions to clear from the server. 13. After waiting for 8-10 hours, all the transactions have been downloaded, and the attendance punch is now showing properly in the attendance sheet.

We can’t not find any Punching data after 1730 hrs. onward from 23.12.2024 to till now at ZHL Sikkim Unit 1. Therefore, we are not able to check any Employee IN & OUT Time. Note: All Turnstile are in working condition & Successful card & Finger Punch are going on but details are not downloading. Kindly suggest & do needful.
comments: Waiting for clear pending transations.
solution: 1. The client reported that attendance punches have not been showing for the last two days, and tomorrow is the payroll processing day. 2. I found that attendance data is missing across all Zydus locations for the past two days. 3. This case was escalated to the development team. The initial issue is that the iApp is working very slowly, preventing users from performing any tasks in the software. 4. I checked the Zydus server and found that CPU utilization was above 95%. 5. I restarted the Spectra worker service and the IIS server, then waited for a while, but the same issue persisted. 6. I then accessed the Zydus database server and attempted to restart the SQL server service, but I did not have the necessary permissions. I contacted the Zydus HO IT team and requested the required rights. 7. After receiving the rights, I restarted the SQL server, but the issue remained. 8. I discussed the situation with Setul Sir and connected with the development team. Mr. Dhaval Patel from the development team joined the troubleshooting process. 9. We discovered that the "Devicetrans" table contained over 8.1 million records, which was consuming excessive space. We decided to delete unnecessary records from the table. 10. Deleting the records took more than 2 hours to complete. 11. Once the records were deleted, I restarted the Spectra worker service, and the punch data began downloading successfully and at an improved speed. 12. The iApp software is now working properly. I am waiting for all pending transactions to clear from the server. 13. After waiting for 8-10 hours, all the transactions have been downloaded, and the attendance punch is now showing properly in the attendance sheet.

description_plain: Request to please help us delete the miss punch of below employee because misspunch is already approved.
comments:
1. The client was unable to change the shift due to a misspunch that had been approved by the user. They needed to delete the misspunch application, but when they tried, an error message stated that the misspunch application is already approved in the system. 
2. I opened the attendance sheet for the employee and attempted to delete the application, but I encountered the same error. 
3. After that, I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries: 
```sql SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code='137751'; 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply (nolock) WHERE userid='78500' AND attddate='2024/11/23' AND category='mispunch'; 
DELETE FROM adjustapply WHERE userid='78500' AND attddate='2024/11/23' AND category='mispunch'; ``` 
4. The misspunch application has now been deleted, and the user is able to change the employee's shift.

name: iApp
description_plain: Pls check yesterday out punch and today In punch not updated in system. Today is last date to run payroll.
comments:
1. The client reported that attendance punches have not been showing for the last two days, and tomorrow is the payroll processing day.
2. I found that attendance data is missing across all Zydus locations for the past two days.
3. This case was escalated to the development team. The initial issue is that the iApp is working very slowly, preventing users from performing any tasks in the software.
4. I checked the Zydus server and found that CPU utilization was above 95%.
5. I restarted the Spectra worker service and the IIS server, then waited for a while, but the same issue persisted.
6. I then accessed the Zydus database server and attempted to restart the SQL server service, but I did not have the necessary permissions. I contacted the Zydus HO IT team and requested the required rights.
7. After receiving the rights, I restarted the SQL server, but the issue remained.
8. I discussed the situation with Setul Sir and connected with the development team. Mr. Dhaval Patel from the development team joined the troubleshooting process.
9. We discovered that the "Devicetrans" table contained over 8.1 million records, which was consuming excessive space. We decided to delete unnecessary records from the table.
10. Deleting the records took more than 2 hours to complete.
11. Once the records were deleted, I restarted the Spectra worker service, and the punch data began downloading successfully and at an improved speed.
12. The iApp software is now working properly. I am waiting for all pending transactions to clear from the server.

name: iApp
description_plain: VMS system does not working properly please resolve issue
comments: 1. The client reported that attendance punches have not been showing for the last two days, and tomorrow is the payroll processing day. 2. I found that attendance data is missing across all Zydus locations for the past two days. 3. This case was escalated to the development team. The initial issue is that the iApp is working very slowly, preventing users from performing any tasks in the software. 4. I checked the Zydus server and found that CPU utilization was above 95%. 5. I restarted the Spectra worker service and the IIS server, then waited for a while, but the same issue persisted. 6. I then accessed the Zydus database server and attempted to restart the SQL server service, but I did not have the necessary permissions. I contacted the Zydus HO IT team and requested the required rights. 7. After receiving the rights, I restarted the SQL server, but the issue remained. 8. I discussed the situation with Setul Sir and connected with the development team. Mr. Dhaval Patel from the development team joined the troubleshooting process. 9. We discovered that the "Devicetrans" table contained over 8.1 million records, which was consuming excessive space. We decided to delete unnecessary records from the table. 10. Deleting the records took more than 2 hours to complete. 11. Once the records were deleted, I restarted the Spectra worker service, and the punch data began downloading successfully and at an improved speed. 12. The iApp software is now working properly. I am waiting for all pending transactions to clear from the server.
solution: VMS is working fine now, and after deleting unwanted data from the database, the software speed is back to normal.

description_plain: your immediate attention a critical system bug in iAPP. Our LC policy (Tardiness Policy) is currently not processing, which is significantly impacting our payroll operations. We are delayed because of this activity. Given the urgency of this matter, we request your prompt assistance in resolving this issue to prevent further disruptions
comments:
1. When starting the late entitlement policy in payroll, it restarts automatically, and the late auto application is not reflected in the system.
2. I discussed this with the internal team and found that the Spectra worker process restarted, which is why the late auto application is not reflected in the attendance.
3. After that, we set the stop process procedure and started the payroll process for all locations, one by one.
4. I connected with Jignesh Sir and processed each location one by one. In the Alidac location, the late permission was not showing.
5. After multiple attempts, it was still not showing, so I connected with the plant HR and found that no applications had been applied by the employee.
6. After completing all the locations, we checked, and now all the late auto policies are reflected in the system.
7. The client needed a record of the payroll process for completed locations, so I went to the database and executed the following query:
   - `SELECT l.name, M.ExecuteDate FROM MachineData m (nolock) JOIN Location l ON m.locationid = l.id WHERE m.Status = 'S' AND m.CommandType LIKE '%Payroll%'`
8. I found all the locations, created a notepad file with this data, removed duplicate records, and shared it with the client.

name: iApp
description_plain: This requirement is urgent hence pls provide your convenience time as we have fixed the new punching machine with electric & LAN connectivity.
comments:
1. The client needs to configure the new device, but due to a LAN connection issue on their side, the IP is not active.  
2. I contacted the IT team, and they resolved the issue. After that, they connected with me for further action.
solution:
1. The client reported that a new device needs to be configured in the attendance packing area.
2. I requested them to share the IP of the device so I could check whether the device IP is working on the server.
3. The IT team shared the device IP, but it was not working on the server. They checked another IP, and I guided them to insert the IP into the device parameters, but it still didn’t work.
4. After that, they checked the LAN connection and other network-related issues, but it was still not working. I suggested they check the IP range.
5. The IT team checked with their internal team and then assigned a new IP. This new device IP is now working on the server.
6. I opened the bootloader application, searched for the device, and it was showing. I set the device parameters and updated the device firmware.
7. After that, I opened the software, added the device, and the command went through successfully.
8. I went to the card format and set the card format on the device, and turned off the free scan feature.
9. The client needed a digital clock on the device, so I set the digital clock in the device parameters.
10. The device needed to be added to an access group, so I added the device to the existing group and started the user dump process on the device.
11. After waiting for some time, the user dump process did not start. I went to the server and found that, in the Dabhasa plant, a user had started the user dump process on six devices at the same time. I removed all the machineheader and machinedata commands with the following queries:

   ```sql
   Select * from machineheader(nolock) where commandstatus='P'
   Select * from machinedata(Nolock) where controllerid='' and status='P'
   ```
12. After removing the commands, the user dump process started, and I waited for some time to allow it to complete.
13. Once the process was completed, the client confirmed that the device punching was working fine.

description_plain: Please find attached the screenshot below. The ACS transactions for the following employees are not showing. We have also verified the master record, but the turnstile punching record are not being reflected. Kindly look into this issue and resolve it at the earliest.
comments:
1. The client reported that many employees' ACS transactions are not showing, which is preventing us from approving the misspunch applications because the access transactions are not visible.
2. I opened the database menu and found that one turnstile device is showing as inactive in the software.
3. I accessed the Zydus server and checked the device IP ping, which was not working on the server. I then selected one missing employee transaction, went to the service data log files, and copied all the log files.
4. I extracted the log files using the log extractor application and searched for the transactions using the employee's card ID. I found that 2 transactions were not showing. I then checked the device and discovered that the device showing as inactive in the software was causing the transactions to remain pending.
5. After checking 2-3 more employees and finding the same issue, I requested the client to connect with their IT team and check the network connectivity.
solution:
Based on your mention, we assume ACS refers to the Access Control System.

From the provided employee list, we conducted troubleshooting on employee code 150507. Upon checking the Employee Master under the Miscellaneous section, we found two punch records:

    IN Punch at 23:21:49 on the Fill in Finished Device

    OUT Punch at 23:26:35 on the OUT-Device-T5 Biologics (Turnstile)

However, As you mentioned that you were unable to find the transaction for this employee. Upon verification in the Access Control module, we confirmed that the transaction exists.

We also accessed the server remotely, checked the database and service Datalog files, and found the same records in both the Miscellaneous section and the Transaction View.

Please review the details from your end and let us know if we have missed anything.

Additionally, we would like to highlight that if you are referring to the attendance sheet of the employee, we observed that only the IN punch is displayed, while the Turnstile punch is missing for mention dates. Upon checking the Access Control Attendance settings, we found that the Turnstile device has not been added, which is why its punch data is not reflecting in the attendance sheet.

name: iApp
description_plain: All the attendance policies are assigned to employee ID 151057, but the attendance sheet is not showing.
comments:
1. The client reported that the attendance sheet is not generated for employee ID 151057, even though the policy has already been assigned to them.
2. I opened the attendance sheet and found that it was not generated. I checked the policies, and all the policies were assigned correctly with the correct effective date.
3. Then, I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query:
   `Select * from scheduleprocess(nolock) where status='P'`
4. I found that a total of 222 processes were stuck because the stop process procedure was running.
5. I stopped the Spectra worker service, removed the stop process file, and restarted the service. Then, I waited for some time to allow all the scheduler processes that were pending to clear.
6. After waiting for some time, all the processes were cleared, and the attendance sheet is now showing properly.

name: iApp
ticket_title: Re: GG Valves Pvt Ltd ( Udaipur)
description_plain: Error showing in Attendance
comments: As discussed, we will connect on Monday if possible.
solution:
1. I connected with the client via remote access and found that the attendance data from December 30th was not showing in the software.
2. After that, I checked and found that the ARSwin downloading executable was not working properly, so I started the executable and ran the DLL statement.
3. There are six companies whose data is not showing in the software.
4. The new process year was already created by Mr. Ravi, but it generated the wrong process years for 2025 and 2026, which is why the data is not showing.
5. I then opened the Oracle database and deleted both process years using a query.
6. I started the ARSwin downloading executable, but OCX and some database table errors appeared.
7. Although we had already registered the DLL and OCX files in the software, the same error persisted. I discussed the matter with Ketul and Mr. Viral from the development team. They suggested that there is a table missing in the 2025 and 2026 year databases, which is why the error occurred.
8. I altered the query and inserted the table for all six companies using the following SQL statement:  
   `ALTER TABLE table_name ADD column_name column_definition;`
9. The downloading process then started successfully with no errors, and I waited for some time for all the pending data to be downloaded from the device.
10. After the data was downloaded successfully, many punches were still not showing in the software. So, I opened the ARSwin log file, copied all the log data from December 30th to January 6th, and created a new log file to review the data.
11. After creating the log file, I placed it in the location folder, started the downloading process, selected the log file to read, and waited for some time.
12. The process was completed successfully, and the attendance data is now showing correctly in the software.

description_plain: Dear team, it's observed that, all plant punch automatically stop. The username is automatically removed from the device and all employees are unable to punch in devise. The device is also showing an error on the display.(Error:- herr.0x00000800) Pl check and resolve the problem.
comments: User will connect us at 3 PM.
solution: We discussed over a call that the client is facing an issue with the Bio Scribe 3S device. The remaining finger menu option covers the rest of the screen, and employees, either accidentally or intentionally, click on the menu. As a result, the client claims they are unable to punch in because the menu stays open, and they have to open the door to let the employee in without a punch. To resolve this, the user asked if we can set a timeout on the device so that once the menu is open for a few seconds, the home screen should reappear. We checked in iApp under Device Display Settings but couldn't find any relevant option for this issue. We also discussed the matter with our hardware engineer, who confirmed that this feature is not feasible on the device. The user will need to uncover the remaining screen for the device to function properly. To overcome this issue, we also guided the user to consider purchasing the Bio Stamp 2C, which does not have a display and only includes the Finger + Card module.

name: iApp
description_plain: Please resolve OT error (Pending At System) in the system. Below trail mail for your kind refence and perusal. On dated 24/12/2024 overtime shows pending at system. Employee id 141948
comments:
1. The client reported that although the overtime hierarchy final approval has been changed, the overtime applications are still showing as pending in the system. 
2. To address this issue, I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query to clear all pending OT applications: 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply (nolock) WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1 AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-09-26' AND '2024-12-29' 
UPDATE adjustapply SET f7 = NULL WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1 AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-09-26' AND '2024-12-29' 
3. After executing the update and allowing some time for processing, all the OT applications were successfully cleared. 
4. Now Pending OT has been cleared and OT is showing pending at respective approval.

5. Wait for 1 day to show the data and on next day now data is showing correctly.

name: iApp
description_plain: Pls note that the punching machine GN-5 is not working. Kindly arrange to resolve the issue at the earliest.
comments:
1. The client reported that the GN-5 device is not working and is showing as hung.  
2. I opened the database page and found that the GN-5 device is showing as active. I then connected with the client, and some misunderstanding occurred. I requested them to kindly provide the device IP and found that it was a different device, which turned out to be the warehouse device.  
3. I rechecked the warehouse device, and it was showing as inactive in the software. I then accessed the Zydus server and pinged the device IP, but the IP was not responding.  
4. Additionally, the device display was not showing any information. The client's requirement was to transfer access to another device, but due to the device being disconnected, I was unable to transfer the access.  
5. The client is now connected with their IT team regarding the connectivity issue and will get back to us.
solution:
Two device replacements have been completed, and I performed the following activities:
1. First, I guided the user on how to enter the device parameters. After that, the device showed as active in the server.
2. I updated the firmware of the device and added it to the software.
3. Next, I set the card format for the device, added it to the attendance settings, and turned off the free scan mode.
4. I performed a factory reset on the device, added it to the access groups, and started the user dump process.
5. I waited for some time to allow the user dump process to complete, and now the device is working fine.

1. The client reported that the finger access has already been assigned, but it is not working on the device. When both employees punch on the device, it shows "finger not found" on the device display.  
2. I opened the employee master, edited both employees one by one, and went to the miscellaneous transactions. I found that only one device, LYO Vatva, is showing "finger not found" for both employees.  
3. I then went to the user identification page, and the finger data was showing as correctly taken by HR.  
4. After that, I went to the "Get Finger" section and fetched the fingerprints for both employees, and both employees' fingerprints were found.  
5. I then went to the assign access menu, provided access to both employees, and the command was successfully executed on the device. The finger access is now working fine.
solution:

2. I opened the employee master, edited both employees one by one, and went to the miscellaneous transactions. I found that only one device, LYO Vatva, is showing "finger not found" for both employees.  
3. I then went to the user identification page, and the finger data was showing as correctly taken by HR.  
4. After that, I went to the "Get Finger" section and fetched the fingerprints for both employees, and both employees' fingerprints were found.  
5. I then went to the assign access menu, provided access to both employees, and the command was successfully executed on the device. The finger access is now working fine.

description_plain: Security Monitor issue where data is not correctly populating
comments: Kindly provide contact details of concern  person so we can connect.
solution: Once we connected, we received confirmation from the client side that the headcount for the Airol Site Security Monitor is showing correctly. However, one count is displayed differently without any user type. To investigate the issue, we took remote access to the server and performed the following queries to identify the cause: SELECT * FROM Muster (where we referred to the location ID to check further). SELECT * FROM Musterdetails WHERE reportid = '16' AND status IS NULL (We found one record with a null status, and the card ID was different from the database). We then deleted that record using the query: DELETE FROM Musterdetails WHERE reportid = '16' AND status IS NULL. After that, we refreshed the Security Monitor, and it is now showing the correct headcount, as we confirmed.

name: ARSWin-Net
description_plain: We have been facing issues with the biometric system and access doors since last night, which is raising high concerns regarding physical security at our office.
comments: We took a remote session with the user and found that the user has one controller along with a four-reader configuration. The problem is that whenever any employee accesses the door, it opens and remains open indefinitely, requiring manual closure. Please find the attached video for your reference.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that the user has one controller configured with four doors. The issue is that whenever any employee punches in on the door, it opens, but remains open and does not close automatically.

To rectify this, we checked all the device-related GPO and GPI connections, which seemed to be fine. These doors are configured as fire exit doors, and the fire panel is also integrated with the Spectra controller.

For better understanding, we asked the user to provide a video of the door not closing after punching in. We reviewed the video with our Gurgaon hardware team and determined that there is no issue from the software or hardware side. The issue lies with the fire panel relay.

We asked the user to remove the fire panel relay, then punch in on the device and check again. After removing the fire panel relay the doors are working fine, and the issue is from the fire panel side.
We have also checked the event logs in the software to verify that there is no issue from the software side.

name: iApp
description_plain: While creating the VMS for visitor in ZTL plant, it was found that multiple entries have been created by system for the same visitor. Requesting you to please delete the same. User Id- Security08 SCREENSHOT IS ATTACHED FOR YOUR REFERENCE PLEASE.
comments: We regret to inform you that we are unable to extend our support services in the absence of comprehensive AMC coverage. Please reach out to your Head Office HR team or GDSO for further clarity.
solution:
1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 200 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID. 
2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from Sept. 1, 2024, to March, 2024, and found more than 500 duplicate entries for  Zydus alidac location. 
3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: 
Select * into Visitor_18122024 from Visitor 
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: 
Select * from Location 
Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='2' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: 
Delete from Visitor where id='666167' 
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.

7. Click on Script and then Execute.
8. Start the download process.

Now, the application is running as expected, and no issues have been found so far.

description_plain: Dear Spectra Team, Wishing you all a very Happy New Year! We have received multiple complaints and escalations from employees in our Bangalore office regarding issues with the biometric access system. Specifically, employees have reported that the doors only open after 4 to 5 attempts using the biometric access. This has caused frustration, and many employees are unhappy with the current performance of the Spectra device. To address and resolve this issue promptly, I kindly request that you send both a hardware and software technician to the site to inspect the system and implement the necessary fixes. Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. We look forward to your support in ensuring a smooth and efficient access process. Regards UKK( KESAVARAMAN ) 9606230190
comments: We have emailed our Bangalore hardware team for a visit, and they will check their availability and update us.
solution: We conducted a remote session with the user, along with our hardware engineer on-site. During the session, we found that some of the readers were not accepting the employee punches on the first attempt; employees had to punch multiple times for the device to register the input. We then updated the firmware on both the device and the reader. We also dumped the user database and assigned access to all employees for the Bangalore location. Additionally, we configured the finger parameters and asked the user to test the punch on the device. Our hardware engineer confirmed that employees are now able to punch on the device on the first attempt

name: CommunicationSoft
description_plain: When open communication soft downloading then showing OCX registration error.
comments:
1. The client reported that when opening the communication software and running the downloading executable, an OCX and "Subscript out of range" error appeared.  
2. I took remote access, checked the issue, and found that the OCX needed to be registered. However, even after registering the OCX, the same error was still showing.  
3. I closed the communication software and the downloading executable, then restarted the downloading executable by running it as an administrator. After doing so, the error no longer appeared.  
4. I guided the client that the error was caused by a rights issue and recommended contacting their IT team.

name: CommunicationSoft
description_plain: Device transactions are not showing from last 2 days.
comments:
1. The client reported that transactions have not been showing in the communication software for the last 2 days.  
2. I took remote access, opened the downloading executable, and found that no transactions were reflected.  
3. I then opened the software, went to the device status, and found that the device was showing as inactive in the system. I opened the CMD and pinged the device IP, but the device IP was not responding.  
4. I discussed the issue with the client, and he, along with his IT team, checked from the network side and resolved the connectivity issue.  
5. After that, I refreshed the device status page, and the device is now showing as active. I then opened the downloading executable, and the pending transactions are now showing. The concern has been resolved.

name: iApp
description_plain: Access controller First Punch & Last Punch showing same time
comments: Will connect tomorrow in second-half
solution:
During our remote session, we found that the client was facing an issue with attendance, where IN punches were also reflecting as OUT punches. Upon investigation, we discovered that employees were using the Mobile ESS App, which was automatically detecting the geofence and recording punches in both tables. To resolve this, we updated the setup to ignore punches within a 1-minute window, which should help resolve the issue.

Employees were punching in at the devices, but the system was not registering the punches. After checking, we found that the validity of the employees' cards had expired, which was preventing the device from accepting the punches.

For bulk uploading the holiday list, we have instructed the client to upload the CSV file via the "Import Data" option."

5. Select the **2025 database** in the **AlterCollation.exe**.
6. Enter the correct **2024 collation** settings.
7. Click on **Script** and then **Execute**.
8. Start the download process.

description_plain: Urgent visit required for software and hardware related issues.
comments:
==> The client reported that the Biostamp 2C access device's finger recognition was not working properly and was showing an error for "Battery" and "X100" on the display. 
==> As per Ashok sir's instructions, Raj and I from the hardware team visited the location yesterday between 3 PM and 7 PM and resolved the following issues:
1. We first checked all the floor devices and found errors in each of them.
2. I checked the software and found that one group floor device was showing "Waiting." I refreshed it multiple times and restarted the device, but it still displayed "Waiting." So, I accessed the server, opened the database, and executed the following queries:
   - `Select * from controllermaster where ipaddr=''`
   - `Select * from machinedata (nolock) where controllerid='' and status='P'`
3. I found that 400+ machine data entries were stuck and couldn't be cleared. All the commands were unwanted, so I deleted them with the following query:
   - `Delete from machinedata (nolock) where controllerid='' and status='P'`
4. After deleting the commands, I opened the software, but the device still showed "Waiting." I then performed a factory reset on the device.
5. Once the factory reset was completed, I updated the firmware of the device. However, due to improper Wi-Fi connectivity, the firmware update process was failing. So, I connected the device directly to a laptop and updated the firmware. After that, I started the user dump activity.
6. Now, the device is functioning properly, and the punch feature is working.
7. I followed the same process for the other two devices and replaced the CMOS batteries in all the devices, as a CMOS error was found when starting the devices.
8. We confirmed with the client, and now all the devices are working fine.
9. Additionally, there was a reported issue regarding API integration with the Odoo software. I discussed the integration process with the IT team, Odoo team, and Mr. Himanshu for further steps.

name: ARSWin-Net
description_plain: Communication soft to ARS win software attendance data is not reflecting.
comments:
1. The client reported that communication and the ARSwin software are working fine, but data is not reflecting in the ARSwin software.
2. I discussed this matter with Mr. Abhimanyu from the implementation team, as the implementation work was done by his team. I found that only one face scribe device was configured in the communication software, and the ARS path was configured in the communication software. The data is being transferred to the ARSwin software.
3. In the ARSwin software, no devices were available, so I found some DB path configuration issues. 
4. I requested the client to provide remote access to investigate further.
5.. I tried multiple times to connect remotely to the client, but due to network connectivity issues on the client's side, I was unable to connect. 
6. The client confirmed that once the network issue is resolved, they will get back to me for further work.
solution:
1. The network issue has been resolved, and the client shared remote access with me.
2. I opened the communication software for downloading and found that the data was downloading properly.
3. I checked the ARSwin software and went to the spreadsheet. I found that data from December 30th was not showing for any of the employees, and all records were marked as absent.
4. I closed all the applications and restarted both the communication and ARSwin software, but the transactions still were not showing.
5. After that, I went to the ARSwin downloading section, selected all the read log files, and started the download, but the data still didn't reflect.
6. I opened the communication software and checked the ARSwin path configuration. I found that the path table data was incorrect and that the wrong table was selected.
7. I updated the ARSwin path and selected the "Netxsdata" table. After that, I started the download, and the data started coming through properly.
8. I waited for some time to allow all the pending data to download from the device. Afterward, the spreadsheet data began showing correctly in the ARSwin software.

comments:
We took a remote session with the user and found that the user is claiming that employees on the first floor, Wing A, are unable to punch in through their fingers on the Biscribe 2C device, although they can punch in using cards.

We checked the database and asked the user to confirm the device IP from the network parameters. The IP mentioned in the device is 10.132.243.251, which actually belongs to the second floor, Wing A. There might have been a mismatch in the name during configuration.

To resolve this issue, we checked the device management, where the device was showing only card mode. We tried to change it to Card+Finger, but an error occurred, stating a duplicate controller code. We checked the database, and the same controller ID belongs to another device. A snapshot is attached for reference.

To resolve this, we tried changing the mode to "Device Only," but even after changing the mode, the fingerprint light did not turn on. We also set the fingerprint parameters on the device, but the issue remained the same. We concluded that there might be an issue with the device and that the fingerprint sensor is not working. Therefore, the device needs to be sent to our service center for repairs.

Since the client is claiming that this is the main attendance device, they requested a temporary device to be configured while the device is under repair. They have asked for a hardware engineer visit to unmount the current faulty device and mount another device temporarily.

ticket_title: Issue in Vaccine R- Lunch Punching machine -(Food Punching machine)
description_plain: Hello Team, Issue coming from last 2 days in Moraiya Vaccine Canteen (Food punching machine) “No user found”. Checked with IT team also, There is no issue of network. Kindly check and resolve the issue Thanks &
comments: We regret to inform you that we are unable to extend our support services in the absence of comprehensive AMC coverage. Please reach out to your Head Office HR team or GDSO for further clarity.
solution:
1. The client reported that when they punch on the canteen device, a "disconnected" error is displayed, and the punch is not working.
2. I connected with the client and guided them to go to the device location so we could disable the printer slip configuration.
3. After some time, the client went to the device location, and I guided them to unlock the device and go to the network parameters.
4. Then, I instructed them to go to the BLE printer menu and disable the printer slip configuration.
5. Afterward, another error appeared, stating "user not found," which was a card format error. I guided them to go to system settings and set the card format to "ClockData."
6. Now, the canteen punch is working fine.

6. Enter the correct **2024 collation** settings.
7. Click on **Script** and then **Execute**.
8. Start the download process.

solution: We have successfully installed bio mini with below steps and requirement, Step 1 > System must be run by Admin Login Step 2 > Install Spectra Client Setup. Step 3 > Install Spectra Client Driver. Step 3 > Control Panel > Programs & Features > Check Whether Both Setup and drivers installed or not. Step 4 > C Drive > Program files 86 > Spectra (Provide Full Access or rights) > Spectra Client > (Provide Full Access or rights) Step 5 > Bio-mini Folder > Spectra Client folder > Copy all the files . Step 8 > C Drives > Window > System 32 > Paste all the files Step 9 > C Drives > Window > SosWow64 > Paste all the files Step 10 > Install remaining two library from the Spectra Driver folder Step 11 > Open the I app and get the finger.

However, upon attempting to log in again, the executable did not automatically use the saved admin credentials, requiring manual entry of the admin credentials, which is not ideal for them.

We have suggested that the user observe the situation for now and let us know if the downloading executable stops again, so we can proceed further. In the meantime, I will address this requirement with my QC team for a better resolution.

name: iApp
description_plain: Leave accruals issue
comments: As discussed during the call, the user will connect with us at their convenience time.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that the user has three leave types: SL (Monthly), CL (Monthly), and EL (Monthly). In both SL and CL, the opening balance is 7, so during accrual, it is showing 7, and since the leave type is monthly, 7 leaves are being added every month, which is incorrect according to the client. Similarly, in EL, the opening balance is 15, and the same issue is happening.

To rectify this issue, we created two new leave types: SL (Yearly) and CL (Yearly), and we also created a new leave policy for both of these leave types. Additionally, we created a new leave policy for EL, where the employee will receive 15 leaves per year, but on an earning basis. If an employee works for 20 days in a month, they will receive 1.25 EL every month.

We have checked and confirmed the changes, and now everything is working as expected.

name: iApp
description_plain: We have create one number visitor pass but system taking automatically showing 100 time same number please solve the issue.
comments: We regret to inform you that we are unable to extend our support services in the absence of comprehensive AMC coverage. Please reach out to your Head Office HR team or GDSO for further clarity.
solution:
1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 200 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID. 
2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from Dec. 1, 2024, to March, 2025, and found more than 500 duplicate entries for all Zydus locations. 
3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: 
Select * into Visitor_20032025 from Visitor 
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: 
Select * from Location 
Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='22' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: 
Delete from Visitor where id='666167' 
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.

solution: Your requirement is to ensure that the software allows users to apply for full-day leaves (e.g., Half CL/SL, PL/SL, etc.) and restricts them from applying for combination half-day leaves when they are absent. However, if they are present for half a day, the system should allow them to apply for a half-day leaves. Unfortunately, it is not feasible in the current software configuration to restrict users from applying for combination half-day leaves when they are absent. If we enforce this restriction, it would also prevent users from applying for half-day leave when they are present for half a day. Therefore, this functionality is not possible within the software as it stands.

To use NTP client of 3S devices follow these steps.

1.Find an windows system which runs 24/7 or maximum time then other system. In most cases this system would be server PC.
2.In Run Command type “regedit” ,  without quotes
3.In registry editor navigate to following path.
a)Computer\HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\W32Time\TimeProviders\NtpServer
b)Find enabled Key in NTPServer and change value data to 0x00000001 by double clicking on it.
4.Close registery editor.
5.Open control panel.
6.Click on Windows Firewall -> Advance Settings -> Inbound Rules.
7.Click on Advance Settings.
8.Click on new Rule… on right side
9.In newly opened dialogue box:
a)Click on Port Readio button -> next.
b)TCP radio button, Specific Local ports -> enter Value as “123”, without quotes -> next.
c)Allow Connection -> Next.
d)Tick Mark on Domain, Private, Public -> Next.
e)Give Name as “NTP Service” -> Finish.
10.Close all firewall windows.
11.In run Command type “Services.msc”, without quotes and hit Enter.
12.Find “Windows Time Service” open its properties by double clicking on it.
13.Make Start up Type “automatic”. and it service is not running make it so by clicking on Start.
14.Close all windows and ope Iapp.
15.Go to general setup.
16.In General Setup Page.
a)Tick NTP Enable.
b)NTP Local Timezone : select appropriate value.
c)NTP Server Address : provide Ip address of System where we have enabled NTP Service.
d)Click Save close.
17.NTP Client is now enabled, it will sync time with server every 10 minutes.

In conclusion, we have determined that the data from Spectra is available.

Afterward, we asked the employee to punch in on the device, and the punch was successful.

description_plain: Request you to please resolve error as we are unable to download attendance data from 08rd January 2025 onwards. Machine Name: OSD Manufacturing IP Address: 172.24.26.200
comments: We regret to inform you that we are unable to extend our support services in the absence of comprehensive AMC coverage. Please reach out to your Head Office HR team or GDSO for further clarity.
solution:

2. I opened the database menu in the software and found that the device has been showing as inactive since 08/01/2024.  
3. I then pinged the device IP from the Zydus server and confirmed that the IP was active on the server.  
4. I opened the bootloader application, but the device was not found in the bootloader.  
5. I requested the client to go to the device location and informed them that I would wait for some time until they reached the device.  
6. I guided them to unlock the device, access the network settings, and check the IP address, subnet mask, and gateway, all of which were correct.  
7. We then checked the server port, which was incorrectly configured, so I requested them to update it with the correct server port.  
8. After updating the server port, the device showed as active in the software. I requested them to wait for some time to allow the pending transactions to clear, and then to check the software.

Upon reviewing the muster settings, we identified that the configuration was incorrect, specifically in how it displayed out punches, which should not appear in the security monitor. We corrected the muster settings, which resulted in the correct headcount. We also followed up by ensuring all visitor punches were marked as "out," bringing the headcount to zero, as expected.

I previously confirmed that the issue was resolved, but if there are still any concerns, I recommend configuring the attendance in the total work hour section. To do so, please go to Attendance > Shift > Maximum Work Hour
