comments: We regret to inform you that we are unable to extend our support services in the absence of comprehensive AMC coverage. Please reach out to your Head Office HR team or GDSO for further clarity.
solution:
1. The client reported that turnstile data is not showing for the date 30/12/2024 for employee ID 151152.
2. I opened the employee master, went to the miscellaneous menu, and found that there were no punches showing for that day.
3. I also checked the database menu in the software and found that all the devices were active, with no pending transactions on the device.
4. I accessed the Zydus server, went to the services menu, copied all the data log files, and extracted them. I found that data for that day was available.
5. I then copied the log file for the date 30/12/2024, created two recovery folders for the 2C and 3S devices, and pasted the file into them.
6. I restarted the Spectra worker service and waited for a while to recover the log files. After the recovery process was completed, the punches were displayed in the spreadsheet.

description_plain: Most URGENT Why OT is pending with system of E-Code – 115422 Location SEZ
comments: We regret to inform you that we are unable to extend our support services in the absence of comprehensive AMC coverage. Please reach out to your Head Office HR team or GDSO for further clarity.
solution:
1. The client reported that although the overtime hierarchy final approval has been changed, the overtime applications are still showing as pending in the system. 
2. To address this issue, I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query to clear all pending OT applications: 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply (nolock) WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1 AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-11-26' AND '2025-03-15' 
UPDATE adjustapply SET f7 = NULL WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1 AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-11-26' AND '2025-03-15' 
3. After executing the update and allowing some time for processing, all the OT applications were successfully cleared. 
4. Now Pending OT has been cleared and OT is showing pending at respective approval.

name: iApp
description_plain: We have to make changes within created table for third party configuration. Kindly share your availability to connect.
comments:
1. The client reported that they need to add two fields in the third-party integration: device code and device name.  
2. I requested remote access from them so I could check if these fields are available.  
3. After connecting, I opened the third-party integration and checked all the fields multiple times, but I could not find the device code and device name fields, so I was unable to add them.  
4. I discussed this case with Setul Sir and checked the software version, finding that it is version 187, which is old, and that’s why these fields are not showing.  
5. I informed the client that we need to update the software patches so both fields will be visible in the third-party configuration.  
6. The client expressed concern about potential bugs or data loss after updating the software patches. I advised them that we can first update the patches on the UAT server so they can test all modules and data, and once they confirm everything is fine, we can proceed with the software update on the production server.
solution:
1. After the configuration by the client, since there was no UAT server available, we directly updated the software patches on the iApp production server.

description_plain: Spectra team, pl arrange remote for new device [BioScribe] in iApp System awaiting for your response Regards -- Hitesh Padhya TK Office 9662523215
comments: The user will connect after some time once they have established a proper remote connection.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that they had purchased a new Bio Scribe 2C device for the Mansa location and wanted to configure it in iApp. We guided the user to provide a free IP so we could configure the new device. However, the IP provided by the user for the current device was not working. We assisted the user by adding all the necessary network parameters physically on the device.

Upon checking in the bootloader, we found that the device details were updated as per the requirements. We then added the device in iApp with the following steps:

iApp > Attendance Management > Device Management > Device > New > Added a new device > Save

name: ARSWin-Net
description_plain: client want support for New year Leave head (CL, SL & PL) not show in system category of Staff, Worker, Apprentice, Trainee
comments: client will connect after some time
solution:
The client was facing an issue where the CL, PL, and SL balances for new joiners were not being generated. We took remote access to the system and attempted to perform the grant opening. However, we encountered a restriction as the employees had not completed one year of service, which prevented us from proceeding.
We then accessed the server remotely and ran a query, entering the employee location, employee ID, department number, and the type of leave required. After executing the query with the necessary details, we were able to successfully resolve the issue for approximately 100 employees, ensuring that the SL, PL, and CL balances were correctly generated.
The issue has now been resolved.

description_plain: Hello Sir, I would like to inform yout that as per hte discussion we have created the new leave code for Compensetry off as COFF so now on the balance related to coff will be credited on New leave code. The old code which has been used earlier will still be visible till the conformation of balance related to COFF is not shared form your hand. As per previous discussion with Setul Sir and Suresh, and after the discussion in the last meeting, the new leave code, COFF2, was created. It was clearly stated during the meeting itself that no activity could be performed on the old leave code before creating the new leave code.

Still, if you need the previous year's COFF balance, you can download it from the Consolidated Ledger Report option in the report section.

Suresh already commented on mail.

> A new leave code, COFF2, will be created and assigned to the overtime policy.
> The latest leav data will be credited to the new leave code whenever new configuration will done.

2. Veeda Action:

> Veeda team will approve or reject of any pending application of Overtime or Leave application of COff.

>The Veeda team needs to identify the COFF leave balance for all users up to date.

> Once the data is verified and consolidated, the Veeda team will prepare a sheet for importing the data into the preferred leave type (Coff balance will adjustment plus in exsting leave code like PL,SL.There will be not any expiry for the adjusment balance)

Steps to Import the Leave Balance:

> Navigate to Settings > Import > Module as Leave Adjustment (With Effective date)
> Import the prepared data into the system under the desired leave type (not in new coff leave code).

description_plain: Our one employee Mr. Amit Kumar Swain ( Emp. N.133156) out time not show in turnstile data on 04/01/2025. Please do the needful.

solution:

3. I accessed the Zydus server, went to the services menu, and copied all the data log files for the date of 04/01/2025.  
4. After that, I extracted all the data log files using the log extractor application and filtered the data by the employee card ID.  
5. I found the out punch in the log file, so I created a folder for recovery and restarted the Spectra worker service to recover the file.  
6. After waiting for some time, the file recovery was completed, and now the turnstile out punch is showing correctly in the software.

name: iApp
ticket_title: Attendence in and out in the security monitor
description_plain: The client is facing an issue where the headcount is not being recorded correctly during the attendance process. Specifically, when employees punch in at the main gate, the headcount is correctly displayed as 1. However, after punching in at the control room, the headcount remains 1. When employees punch out from the control room, the headcount is displayed as 0, which is incorrect.
comments:
The client was facing an issue with the headcount not being recorded correctly during the attendance process. Specifically, when employees punched in at the main gate, the headcount was displayed as 1. However, after punching in at the control room, the headcount remained 1, and when employees punched out from the control room, the headcount was incorrectly displayed as 0.
Upon taking remote access, we found that the muster settings were incorrect. I made the necessary adjustments, designating the outer gate as "Attendance" and the inner gate as "Turnstile" as per the configuration in the iApp. After the changes, the client tested the system multiple times and confirmed that the issue has been resolved.

description_plain: Dear Team, We’re facing below issues in Security monitor Headcount Software: 1. Client side “Area Head Count” dashboard data not visible 2. Above issue on multiple client PCs (5 nos.)
comments:
We attempted to call the user, but they are currently unreachable via mobile.
We have sent an email to connect at their convenience.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that the user had installed the security monitor on another system. While logging in, the headcount was not showing on that system.

To resolve the issue, we took remote access of the active security monitor system, copied the application folder files, and replaced them on the system where the security monitor was not working.

After this, we checked the security monitor, and the headcount is now showing correctly, matching the main system.

name: Door Interlocking
description_plain: 2 door interlock for QC is not working as we discussed on telephone. Please help us to resolve this issue.
comments:
1. The client reported that the two-door interlocking system is not working, and this is a new installation completed by Mr. Shyam.  
2. I connected with the client to understand the issue and found that they provided access to the employee, but the access is not working and shows "user not found" on the device.  
3. I guided them over a phone call to go to the employee master and reassign access. The command was successfully sent, but the same issue persisted.  
4. I requested remote access to check from here and identify the actual issue.
solution:
1. The client shared the remote access with the team, and I connected remotely. I then opened the NetXsControl software.  
2. I navigated to the controller utility, searched the status of all devices, and found that over 30,000 transactions were pending across all devices.  
3. I discussed with the client to identify which device was experiencing issues, and they shared the details of a QC device. I checked the status and found that over 11,000 transactions were pending on that device.  
4. The NetXsDownloading.exe was not functioning, so I navigated to the file location, launched the executable, selected the controller, and started the downloading process, which began working properly.  
5. I also trained the client on how to start the downloading executable and how to check pending transactions in the software.  
6. I then guided them to wait for a while to allow the pending transactions to clear from the device. Afterward, I instructed them to select all active devices in NetXsDownloading and start the download process to clear all pending transactions.  
7. Once the pending transactions were cleared from the device, I reassigned access to the employee whose access was not working.

name: iApp
description_plain: The Punching Device IN-DEVICE-T5 Biologics finger bio-mini is not working properly. Due to this issue employee and contractual staff suffering problem during entry.
comments: We regret to inform you that we are unable to extend our support services in the absence of comprehensive AMC coverage. Please reach out to your Head Office HR team or GDSO for further clarity.
solution:
1. Our engineer, Mr. Jayesh Patel, visited the location today to configure the new device, so I guided him to kindly enter the device parameters on the device.
2. After that, I took the server and checked the IP, which was showing active. Then, I opened the bootloader application and updated the firmware of the device.
3. I opened the software and saved the new turnstile device, but the command was not going through. So, I opened the Hercules application and executed the following command to factory reset the device:  
   `36 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 36 00`
4. Now that the factory reset was completed and the device command was showing more than 3000, I needed to delete the unwanted commands from the machine data. So, I opened the database and executed the following queries:
   - `Select * from controllermaster where ipaddr=''`
   - `Select * from machinedata(nolock) where controllerid='' and status='P'`
   - `Delete from machinedata(nolock) where controllerid='' and status='P'`
5. After deleting all the stuck machine data, the device command successfully went through.
6. I went to the database menu in the software and started the user dump activity, then waited for some time. However, after a while, the user dump process got stuck, and when I checked the server, I found that the device had automatically gone offline and its IP was no longer active.
7. I connected with the client, and the issue was found to be from the IT side. The IT team worked on the issue, and after some time, the device was showing active again.
8. I needed to delete the command from the machine header and from the machine data using the following query:  
   `Select * from machineheader where commandstatus='P'`
9. After deleting the machine header, I started the user dump activity again and waited for some time to complete the process.
10. Now that the process was completed, I set the card format of the device, and access is working fine now.

4. The rule has been created, and the finger authentication has been successfully disabled.

description_plain: "Now that the pending data download is complete, access is still not working for employees after assigning the access."
comments:
1. The client reported that when trying to search for an employee, a "data binding" error appears, and they are unable to search for employees from the master list and due to this we are not able to edit the employee and assign access to the employee.  
2. I requested remote access from the client so I could check the issue on my end. After some time, the client shared the Teams link, and I connected.  
3. I opened the software, went to the employee master menu, and encountered the same error. I checked the employee names, noting that the text limit for the field is 32 characters. However, I found that the employee names or codes had a maximum of 23 characters.  
4. I edited and saved the employee record, trying multiple times to resolve the issue, but the same error appeared whenever I searched for the employee.  
5. After discussing with the internal team, we concluded that the OCX files needed to be registered on the client's system. I created a OneDrive link for all the OCX files, shared it with the client, and instructed them to download and place the files on their system.  
6. After some time, the client placed the files on the system. I copied all the files to the System32 folder and registered the OCX files via CMD.  
7. The OCX file registration was completed, but when I reopened the software and the employee master, the same error appeared.  
8. I discussed the error with Mr. Viral from the development team, who suggested checking the ODBC connection. I recreated the path file with the SQL database, but the same error persisted.  
9. Mr. Viral then advised me to download the DLL file related to this error and register it on the system. I downloaded the msstdfmt.dll file from Google, generated a OneDrive link for it, and shared it with the client. However, since the IT team was unavailable, the client was unable to download the file.
solution:
1. The client reported that access is not working on 5 devices and that a red light is showing on each device.  
2. I took remote access and first checked the status of all 5 devices, finding no pending transactions for any of them.  
3. I then went to the employee master, edited and saved the employee record, and the command was successfully executed, but punching still wasn't working for the employee.  
4. I opened the bootloader, checked the device firmware, updated it, and reassigned access to the employee, but the issue persisted.  
5. I went to the device parameters and disabled the FP enable settings for all 5 devices. After that, access started working properly.

SELECT AM.WORKHOUR,

    TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(AM.OTSANC, 1, 2)) * 60 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(AM.OTSANC, 4, 2)) AS otsanc_minute,

    ASFC.*
FROM

   eams.ADJUSTAPPLY ASFC
   ON A.USERID = ASFC.USERID
   AND A.ATTDDATE BETWEEN TRUNC(ASFC.DT1) AND TRUNC(ASFC.DT2)
   AND ASFC.CATEGORY = 'ShiftChange'
   AND ASFC.LASTSTATUS = 'G'

    eams.ATTDMAIN AM

    )

name: iApp
description_plain: Iapp working very slow.
comments:
1. The client reported that the iApp application is not working, which is affecting the payroll process, and employees are unable to work on the attendance process.
2. I opened the iApp and found the page was not loading, continuously showing a loading indicator.
3. After that, I checked the Zydus server and found that it was not running properly due to a hang issue.
4. We tried restarting the IIS server and the Spectra worker process multiple times, but the issue persisted.
5. I then opened the database and executed the following query:
   ```sql
   SELECT r.cpu_time AS cpu, s.login_name,
   DATEDIFF(SECOND, last_request_start_time, GETDATE()) AS Seconds,
   s.session_id AS SessionID, blocking_session_id AS Blocking,
   SUBSTRING(st.text, (statement_start_offset/2)+1,
   ABS(((CASE statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text)
   ELSE statement_end_offset
   END - statement_start_offset)/2) + 1 )) AS statement_text,
   OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(objectid, r.database_id) AS SchemaName
   FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
   INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id
   CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(sql_handle) AS st
   ORDER BY Seconds DESC
   ```
6. I found that CPU utilization was above 95%, and one process was taking more than 1200 seconds to execute, so we canceled the process from the database. However, the issue still persisted.
7. I contacted the Zydus HO team, and after discussion, we requested them to increase the CPU cores as many processes were running and the server was struggling due to a lack of sufficient cores.
8. I waited for some time, and the Zydus IT team increased the CPU cores on the Zydus server. After that, the iApp started working properly.

comments:
We also checked the Jindal location and found two transactions with the 9308 Card ID. As per the user's observation, the employee is located at Mata Na Madh, but the punch is showing under the Jindal location device.

To investigate further, we asked the user to provide a remote session for the Jindal location system. We tried to open the Jindal face device portal, but it wasn’t opening. We then asked the user to check the device menu and verify the IP. We found that in the iApp, the device IP was configured as 192.168.0.141, while in the device menu, the IP was showing as 192.168.31.61. We updated the IP in the iApp accordingly.

Next, we checked the face portal control log and found that the same transaction appeared with the same card ID, but the employee name was different. We checked the employee master for Vinod Kumar and found that the 9308 card ID was assigned to him earlier, and his current status showed as "Surrendered," with no other card ID assigned to him.

In conclusion, whenever Vinod Kumar punched on the Jindal device, since no new card ID was assigned, the system used the previous card ID, causing the punch to show under the Mata Na Madh location.

To resolve this issue, kindly assign a new card ID to Vinod Kumar and also register a new face. Additionally, from the Jindal location, we deleted the current card ID for Vinod Kumar and asked the user to observe for one day and update us tomorrow morning if the issue still persists.

For reference, all the snapshots are attached.
solution: We checked and found that duplicate card across jindal site face device , informed to use unique card number and also guided to do not block employee, follow the resign employee process

name: iApp
description_plain: All over zydus locations devices are not showing in the server.
comments:
1. The client reported that all Zydus devices are showing as inactive, and as a result, data is not being received in the software.
2. I opened the database page and found that all the devices are listed as inactive.
3. I then checked the Zydus server and verified that the Spectra Worker service was running correctly.
4. I discovered that the "Recover Data Punch" service was currently running, which was causing all other devices to go offline.
5. I stopped the Spectra Worker service, removed the recover folder from the services, and restarted the worker service. After some time, all the devices became active in the software.
solution:

2. I opened the database page and found that all the devices are listed as inactive.
3. I then checked the Zydus server and verified that the Spectra Worker service was running correctly.
4. I discovered that the "Recover Data Punch" service was currently running, which was causing all other devices to go offline.
5. I stopped the Spectra Worker service, removed the recover folder from the services, and restarted the worker service. After some time, all the devices became active in the software.

comments:

3. After that, I opened the attendance sheet for the mentioned employees and found that most of the data for January 25th was not showing.  
4. I accessed the Zydus server, went to the services menu, copied all the log files for January 25th, and created a new folder.  
5. I opened the log extractor application, extracted all the log files, checked the data, and did not find any missing punches in the log files.  
6. Due to the payroll process, I discussed this matter with Setul Sir, and he suggested that I re-read all the log files.  
7. I copied all the files for that date, created a "Recover3S" folder, restarted the Spectra worker process, and started the log recovery process, waiting for some time for it to complete.  
8. It took a long time to recover over 500 log files, but once the process was completed, the issue was resolved.

description_plain: Dear All, I am writing to bring to your attention a few issues that need urgent resolution · Weekly off changes – It has come to my notice that employees can change their weekly off days. However, I would like to remind everyone that any such changes must first be approved by me before being sent to the HOD for final approval. · Security Gate Computer – The computer at the security gate needs to have the ARSwin net software installed. Could you please arrange for this to be done at the earliest? Your prompt attention to these matters would be greatly appreciated Thank you for your cooperation.
comments:
1. The client reported two concerns: the weekoff change policy and the ARSwin software installation.  
2. We will address these tasks after the Zydus payroll process is completed.
solution:
Client reported two concerns, and below are the answers to both reported queries:
1. **Weekly Off Changes:**  
The client reported that employees can change their weekly off days. However, they want to remind everyone that such changes must be approved by them first before being sent to the HOD for final approval.  
**Comment:** I discussed with the client, and they need to disable the weekly off changes for employees. They need to update the weekly off policy. However, we are not authorized to update the policy, so I guided them to kindly contact Jignesh Prajapati from Zydus HO for further assistance.

2. **Security Gate Computer:**  
The client reported that the computer at the security gate needs to have the ARSwin net software installed. They requested that this be arranged as soon as possible.  
**Comment:** The client requested the installation of the ARSwin software in the security system. I guided them to share remote access so I could check and install the software. After receiving the remote access for both the server and the system, I copied the ARSwin folder from the server system to the security system, transferred the ARSwin setup, and installed the setup. After installation, I copied all the folders and replaced them in the program files. I then registered the four VC files and started the software. The software installation process is now complete.

description_plain: Biomini installation required.
comments:
Client need to install biomini in one system so i open the one drive and create the one drive link for the biomini setup and share to the client.
After that i guide them to how to install biomini setup and share the below steps for this :-
1. First, install the Spectra Client service mentioned below using administrator credentials. Proceed with installation directly upon clicking.
2. Next, install the Suprema BioMini Plus2 driver on the system. Check in the Control Panel to ensure both the Spectra Client service and Suprema drivers are visible.
3. Navigate to the Spectra Client folder, copy all files, and paste them into the following path:
   C:\Program Files (x86)\Spectra\Spectra Client\. 
Grant full administrator rights (Everyone) to the Spectra Client folder after pasting.
4. Proceed to the Suprema BioMini Plus 2 folder. Copy the files as indicated below and paste them into the following paths:
 Paste into: C:\Windows\System32\
 Paste into: C:\Windows\sysWOW64\ 
5. Install the x64 and x86 library files on the system as specified.
6. Access the services and start the Spectra Client service. Once the service is running, the BioMini installation is complete. 
Proceed to the iApp login and Employee Master. Click "Take Finger," then place the finger on the device when the red light blinks to register it on the software.

description_plain: Punch not work from 24/01/25 show massage in punch machine “user block”. Emp ID:133335, 130289
comments:
1. The client reported that a lot of employee punch data is showing as "user block" on the security device.  
2. I opened the employee master, edited the employee records, and found that every punch is showing as "user block" on the device. The employee is already active in the system, and access has already been assigned to them, but the same issue persists.  
3. I opened the database menu in the software and found that the device is an FP1000, which has a finger capacity limit of 1900. Currently, the finger count is over 1910, which is why the device is not accepting new fingerprints from employees.  
4. I discussed this with the client and requested that they kindly remove any unwanted access from the device, delete unnecessary fingerprints, and then reassign access to the employees facing this issue.
solution:
1. The client reported that a lot of employee punch data is showing as "user block" on the security device.  
2. I opened the employee master, edited the employee records, and found that every punch is showing as "user block" on the device. The employee is already active in the system, and access has already been assigned to them, but the same issue persists.  
3. I opened the database menu in the software and found that the device is an FP1000, which has a finger capacity limit of 1900. Currently, the finger count is over 1910, which is why the device is not accepting new fingerprints from employees.  
4. I discussed this with the client and requested that they kindly remove any unwanted access from the device, delete unnecessary fingerprints, and then reassign access to the employees facing this issue.

name: iApp
description_plain: The GRPPL HO device is showing as inactive, and attendance data is not being displayed.
comments:
1. The client reported that the GRPPL HO device has been showing as inactive for a long time, and due to this, attendance data is not displaying in the software.  
2. I opened the database menu in the software and found that the device has been showing as inactive since 03/01/2025.  
3. I accessed the Zydus server, pinged the device IP, and found that the device IP is showing as inactive in the server.  
4. During a conference call with the client and the IT team, we discovered an issue with the LAN cable. The cable was replaced, but the device still showed as inactive.  
5. I guided them to check all the device parameters one by one, and they confirmed that the parameters were correct in the device.  
6. I then guided them to check the network side and identified an IP connection-related issue in the device. I advised them to assign an active IP from their side.
solution:
1. The client connected with me, and the IT team confirmed that the device IP is now working. I accessed the Zydus server, checked the device IP ping, and confirmed that the IP is functioning properly on the Zydus server.  
2. After that, I opened the bootloader application, searched for the device, and it appeared. I then updated the firmware of the device.  
3. I opened the software and navigated to the database menu, where the device is now showing as active.  
4. I initiated the user dump process on the device and waited for it to complete.  
5. The dump process has now completed, and the device is working fine.

description_plain: the client issue is they are not getting the download data and also having error of user not found
comments: The client was experiencing a downloading error as well as a "user not found" error. After accessing the system remotely, we discovered that the data storage was limited. I adjusted the settings to enable unlimited data storage, which allowed the download process to begin. However, the data still wasn't appearing in the NetXS system, so I initiated the synchronization process. Once the sync was complete, the data began to flow correctly. I then instructed the client to punch in, and upon doing so, they received the card, which I had previously inserted into the controller. After this, the issue was resolved.

name: ARSWin-Net
description_plain: Error coming when creating the new process year from 31/12/2024(we tried to create the new process year on 31/12/2024),automatic email generation for attendance is also not working.
comments: We'll connect tomorrow morning at 11:00
solution:
As the client was facing ALTER COLLARATION ERROR, We resolved that issue with the following steps:
1. Transfer the **AlterCollation.exe** file to the SQL Server.
2. Verify the collation settings for the years **2024** and **2025**.
3. Open **AlterCollation.exe** by right-clicking and selecting **Run as Administrator**.
4. Enter the necessary **SQL Server details** (Server Name, User ID, and Password).
5. Select the **2025 database** in the **AlterCollation.exe**.
6. Enter the correct **2024 collation** settings.
7. Click on **Script** and then **Execute**.
8. Start the download process.
which resolved the issue.

1. The client reported that the card+finger is not working for all employees, and employees can only access the system using their finger.
2. I guided the client to go to the device and punch in any employee's card, and the card was sensed properly. However, employees could only punch using their finger, so the client requested to disable the finger authentication punch on the devices.
3. As per the client’s requirement, he needed to disable the free scan mode on the device. I navigated to the finger parameter page in the software, selected two devices, and turned off the free scan mode for both devices.
4. Now, the finger scan mode is off, and employees can use the card+finger device mode to punch in.

name: NetXsControl Ent.
description_plain: As discussed, please help German Remedies team to configure production dept device to existing NetXs and if it's not available then install free version software.
comments:
1. The client's requirement is to assign specific report rights for a particular door. However, when we assign the rights for the report, all doors are showing, and the rights for the particular door are not visible. Therefore, it is not feasible to assign report rights to a specific door.
2. The client needs to install the NetXControl free version for two specific doors. I contacted the AMC team, but they denied starting the process due to the absence of an AMC. I have transferred this call to the AMC team for further assistance.
solution:
1. I downloaded the NetXControl free setup from here, uploaded the file, and shared the link with the client.
2. When the client clicked on the link to download the setup, it was blocked, so I guided them to download the file without using the Zydus network. It took some time for the client to download the file.
3. After the download was successfully completed, I requested the client to kindly share remote access via Teams. Once granted, I connected to the remote access and started the activity.
4. First, I installed the NetXControl setup, opened the software with the MS Access database, and began the configuration of the two devices.
5. These two devices were already installed in iApp and needed to be installed in NetXControl. To do this, I had to change the firmware of the devices. I created a device link to share the firmware file with the client.
6. After waiting some time, the firmware file was downloaded, so I opened the bootloader and updated the firmware of both devices.
7. I opened the software, checked the device status, and confirmed that both devices were showing on the network, so I set the card format for the devices.
8. After that, I started the NetXDownloading.exe and selected both devices.
9. I went to the TimeZoneXS group, added both devices, and assigned the employee to the access group.
10. I went to the Controller Utility, first deleted the database users, and then dumped the PC to the database for both devices. Now, one user was successfully showing.
11. I guided the client to kindly punch on both devices. The entry device was working fine, but the exit device was showing "user not found."
12. I also went to the rights menu, selected all rights for the user, and now the software was working fine.

ticket_title: Attendance not shown in attendance sheet
description_plain: Attendance not shown in attendance sheet
comments: I check and found that device is not inserted in Attendace setting which used for move data from access module to attendace module .
solution:
Employee punch inserted in attendance table 

INSERT INTO dbo.AttdDetails (isManual, cid, punchdatetime,     
       cardid, inoutflag, empid, processflag,remark)    
      select 'N' isMANUAL,t.CID,
          DATEADD(second,-DATEPART(second,t.PunchDetail),t.PunchDetail),
          t.CardID,
          case when t.inout='0' then 'I' else 'O' end INOUT,
          t.empid,'P' Processflag,'Q' from  
        (select * FROM trans where locationid = '2' and cid in ('28','29') and 
        ErrDesc in ('Access Allowed','Success Punch')) t left join AttdDetails ad
  on ad.cid = t.CID 
   AND t.empid = ad.empid and t.GateID = ad.doorid 
   and t.cardid = ad.cardid and DATEADD(second,-DATEPART(second,t.PunchDetail),t.PunchDetail)
    = ad.punchdatetime where 
        ad.Autoid is null and 
        t.PunchDetail >= '2025-01-27 00:01' and t.PunchDetail <= '2025-01-30 18:36'  --AND t.EmpID='10503'
        ORDER BY punchdetail

name: iApp
description_plain: As our canteen punching machine is not working properly, we have installed new punching machine. details of the new machine are as mentioned below.
comments:
1. The client reported that they need to replace the canteen device, which was newly purchased. I connected with the client and guided them to go to the device location and insert the device parameters.
2. After the client inserted the device parameters, the device IP is now showing as active on the Zydus server.
3. I tried to open the bootloader, but it didn't open due to an issue from the Zydus IT team. I then attempted to add the device to the canteen, but the command did not go through.
4. I requested the client to check the device firmware, and upon investigation, it was found that the device is running attendance firmware. Therefore, the device firmware needs to be updated.
5. Since the bootloader is unable to detect the device across all of Zydus, I am unable to update the firmware. I have emailed and discussed the issue with the Zydus HO IT team, requesting them to check and provide us with an update.
solution:
1. After discussing with the IT team, we shared the UDP port and server port for all the devices. After some time, the Zydus HO IT team enabled the port, and I connected to the Zydus server to check whether the device was showing in bootloader mode.
2. After that, I searched for the device, but it was still not showing. However, another device in the same IP range was visible. I checked the subnet mask and gateway of the other device and guided the client to input the same parameters in the canteen device. After that, the device appeared in bootloader mode.
3. I updated the firmware of the device, then opened the software, added the device to the canteen, saved the parameters, and confirmed that the command was successfully executed in the software.
4. I went to the operation menu, performed a factory reset on the device, and started the user dump activity on the device.
5. After waiting for some time, the user dump activity was completed, and the device is now working fine.

name: iApp
description_plain: Showing clock data error on the device.
comments:
1. The client reported that one turnstile device is showing a clock data error on the device display when they try to punch in, and the device is not working.
2. I opened the database menu and found that the device was showing as inactive. I checked the Zydus server, and the device IP was pinging properly.
3. I then attempted to search for the device in the bootloader, but since the bootloader is not working due to an issue from the Zydus HO side, I was unable to locate the device in the bootloader application across all of Zydus.
4. I requested the client to go to the device location and power off the device. After powering off, the device IP was not working, so the IP conflict issue was not found. I then asked them to restart the device, and after that, the device showed as active in the software.
5. I went to the card format menu and set the card format on the device, but the same error continued to show on the device.
6. I guided the client to go to the card format section on the device and manually set the card format, but the issue persisted.
7. I discussed the issue with Jatin sir, who advised me to perform a factory reset on the device. After following his guidance, I reset the device in the operation menu and started the user dump activity on the device.
8. I waited for the user dump process to complete on the device, and once it was finished, I set the card format again.
9. The same error persisted, so Jatin sir informed me that this is likely a hardware issue with the card module. I then requested the client to send the device back to the Spectra service center for repair, so our hardware team can check and resolve the issue.

description_plain: Dear Team, we want to know the reason (RCA) about the below controller why it was not working for at least 5 minutes on 28-Jan’25 at 12:22 am and the facility department was stuck in the hub room, and they swiped their access card multiple times to get out from the hub room. But the access door did not open which is integrated with controller 172.20.90.141, the hub room and other three doors which were connected to the same controller were not opening at that time. After resetting the controller all the doors started opening properly. Controller IP:- 172.20.90.141 Thanks & Regards Vikas Shakya CCTV & Access Control Team Landline:-01244589010/9010
comments: Forward to yogesh bhai.
solution:
As discussed, please find the RCA for the reported issue below:

    Observation:
        The device controller intermittently stops functioning.
        Upon restarting the SMPS , the controller resumes normal operation.

    Analysis:
        The issue appears to be related to insufficient power supply to the controller.
        The SMPS is likely overheating, leading to reduced power output. When the device is restarted, the SMPS is also restarted, temporarily resolving the issue by restoring adequate power supply to the controller.

    Probable Cause:
        Overheating of the SMPS due to continuous load.
        This results in a drop in power delivery to the controller, affecting its normal functioning.

Requested to arrange the SMPS change for this controller.

description_plain: Need to install netxscontrol software in one another system.
comments:
1. The client needs to install the NetXControl software, so I kindly request them to provide remote access so I can begin this activity.

3. The client faced some issues while downloading the setup, but they got in touch with us after the download process was completed.
solution:
1. The Netxscontrol setup download has completed. I connected via Teams for remote access, and the IT team provided me with the security system to install Netxscontrol on the client system.
2. I requested server access, and after some time, they granted it. I checked the server, copied the Netxscontrol folder, and requested them to place this folder on the client system.
3. After that, I started the installation of the Netxscontrol setup and waited for the installation process to complete.
4. Now, I replaced all the Netxscontrol files with the database path and registered all the OCX files using CMD commands one by one.
5. After that, I opened the Netxscontrol software and checked the download. Now, the software is working fine.

name: iApp
description_plain: 39 Duplicate entry of visitors showing in front desk at topical unit.
comments: 1. The client reported that employee ID 151838's access is not working, so I checked the transaction data and found that all the transactions are showing correctly. 2. I requested the client to please share the device IP so I can check it from my side as well.
solution:
1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 200 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID. 
2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from Oct. 1, 2024, to Feb 21, 2025, and found more than 500 duplicate entries for zydus topical location. 
3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: 
Select * into Visitor_21022025 from Visitor 
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: 
Select * from Location 
Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='18' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: 
Delete from Visitor where id='666167' 
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu for that location.

description_plain: Below mentioned employee’s Gate Entry & Punching Time not showing in system. Plz share the details ASAP. Khatri Mohitkumar 11/12/24 In Time not show in turnstile system 07:38
comments:
1. The client reported that the turnstile and attendance punch are not showing in the employee master for the date of 11/12/2024.  
2. I opened the employee master and found that the employee is marked as relieved from the system. I then checked the attendance spreadsheet and found that only the morning punch was showing for that day.  
3. I accessed the Zydus server, went to the services menu, and copied all the data logs for the date of 11/12/2024.  
4. After that, I extracted the data logs using the log extractor, filtered by card ID, and found that an out punch was recorded in the log for that day.  
5. I took the log file, created a recovery folder in the services, and restarted the Spectra worker service.  
6. After waiting for some time, the data log file was recovered, and the punch now appears in the software.
solution:
1. The client reported that the turnstile and attendance punch are not showing in the employee master for the date of 11/12/2024.  
2. I opened the employee master and found that the employee is marked as relieved from the system. I then checked the attendance spreadsheet and found that only the morning punch was showing for that day.  
3. I accessed the Zydus server, went to the services menu, and copied all the data logs for the date of 11/12/2024.  
4. After that, I extracted the data logs using the log extractor, filtered by card ID, and found that an out punch was recorded in the log for that day.  
5. I took the log file, created a recovery folder in the services, and restarted the Spectra worker service.

comments:
1. The client reported that the device is not working, and when they try to punch on the device, it shows a "Printer Disconnected" error.
2. I requested them to go to the device location and unlock the device as we need to disable certain settings.
3. The client went to the device location, and I guided them to navigate to the network parameters and Bluetooth server settings to disable the printer slip configuration.
4. After that, another error—"Card Format Error"—appeared. I guided them to go to the system settings menu, select the card format, choose the "Clock Data Card Format," and after that, the access was working fine with no errors showing on the device display.

name: iApp
description_plain: New attendance device configuration at the Zydus Topical Plant.
comments:
1. The client needs to install a new attendance device at the Topical location, so I discussed it with the internal hardware team and found that this is a new device purchased by the client.
2. I contacted the client and found that they are on leave, so the client shared another person’s contact number with me.
3. I connected multiple times and guided them on the process to go to the device location and insert the IP address, subnet mask, and gateway in the device so we can locate the IP on the server. However, they are busy at the moment and are unable to insert the device parameters.
solution:
1. The client escalated to higher authorities requesting urgent installation of an attendance device due to an audit at the site.  
2. Our hardware engineer, Mr. Nirav Patel, visited the plant with the new device and installed it on-site.  
3. I connected to the Zydus server, but the IP was not showing as active, so I guided them to insert the device parameters. After that, I updated the firmware of the device, and now the device IP is showing as active on the server.  
4. I accessed the software, deactivated the old device, and added the new device for the specific location.  
5. After saving the device settings, the command still wasn't going through, so I performed a factory reset on the device using the Hercules application with the following command:  
   `36 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 36 00`.  
6. After that, I saved the device settings again, and the command was successfully executed.  
7. I then went to the set card format menu, set the clock data format on the device, and went to the access groups to save the device in multiple access groups.  
8. After that, I started the user dump process and waited for some time for the process to complete.  
9. Once the process was completed, I went to the attendance settings menu, added the device, went to the device parameters, and turned off the free scan mode of the device.  
10. Now, the punches are working properly, and the transactions are showing in the software.

description_plain: As discussed, please help us for resolved the punching machine error (System Busy) as per the below details. Serial Number: 1101952 Machine IP: 172.24.30.58 Machine Name : QC 1 – Floor (Lift Side)
comments: We regret to inform you that we are unable to extend our support services in the absence of comprehensive AMC coverage. Please reach out to your Head Office HR team or GDSO for further clarity.
solution:
1. I connected with the client and observed that the device display was showing a 'system busy' error.
2. I accessed the database menu in the software and found that the device was in 'waiting' mode, with users and fingerprint data not displaying.
3. I connected to the Zydus server, searched for the device using the bootloader application, and confirmed it was functioning properly.
4. I executed the following queries in the database menu:
   ```sql
   SELECT * FROM ControllerMaster WHERE IPAddr = ''
   SELECT * FROM MachineData WHERE ControllerID = '' AND Status = 'P'
   ``-
5. I discovered over 10,000 pending machine data entries on the device, which was causing it to malfunction.
6. I monitored the system, but the pending machine data cleared very slowly. We decided to wait for one day to allow all the data to clear. After this period, the 'system busy' error was resolved, and the device is now functioning properly.

name: ARSWin-Net
description_plain: ARS leave updation
comments: Forwarding to Ketulbhai
solution:
We connected via UltraViewer and discussed the issue with the client regarding the leave balance discrepancies. The issue was identified as follows:

1. RH/EL Leave Balance Not Displayed:

RH Leave: The RH leave balance is not visible in the software for some employees. This is because HR did not grant the opening balance for the RH leave code, which is why users are unable to see it in the software and ARSBrowser.
EL Leave: The issue with the EL leave code is that the user did not configure the policy correctly, which is why it is not showing up in the software and ARSBrowser.

2. Punch-in Issue for Some Users:
Some users were unable to punch in on the admin-blocked device. We dumped the data into the machine or go to employee master and give access to user, and now users are able to punch in without any issues.

3. Leave Policy PDF Upload Process:
We guided Pravin from SWPIE Technology on how to upload the Leave Policy PDF. The process involves the following steps:

> Open IIS and navigate to the ARSBrowser path.
> Copy the LeavePolicy.htm file.
> Convert the Leave Policy PDF to an HTML file using Google Converter.
> Rename the file as LeavePolicy.htm.
> Replace the existing file in the ARSBrowser page and restart IIS to apply the changes.

description_plain: Dear All This is to inform you that we have highlights the 02 Major issues which is pending from long time , it is not settled yet , you are requested to kindly address it & resolve it on urgent Basis. . The Details is us under. 1. Not proper problem solving answer received from your Team Members. 2. Problem in shift allocation as per attachment
comments:
Dear Sir,

Following our remote session, we identified two issues that were causing difficulties in manually adjusting the shifts:

CNC3 Shift Timing: The CNC3 shift starts at 23:30 and ends at 08:00. However, due to the maximum shift duration being 18 hours, the system was incorrectly ending the shift at 17:30 the next day. Since your CNC2 shift starts at 15:30, the first punch for the CNC2 shift was being assigned to the CNC3 shift. To resolve this, we have reduced the maximum shift duration from 18 hours to 15 hours.

For example, if an employee completes their CNC3 shift on 03-02-2025, the shift will now end at 17:30 on 04-02-2025 (instead of 08:00). If the employee punches in at 15:30 for CNC2 on 04-02-2025, the system will correctly assign the punch to CNC2.

Auto Shift Issue: We observed that the CNC2 shift ends at 21:00 and the CNC3 shift starts at 21:01. However, employees were arriving at 20:00, which caused the auto shift to be assigned to CNC2 instead of CNC3. To address this, we have updated the shift timings: the CNC2 end time has been changed from 21:00 to 19:30, and the CNC3 start time has been adjusted to 19:31.

Currently, we have put the system under observation until 13-Feb-2025. We will provide you with an update or connect with you on 14-Feb-2025.

Thank you for your patience,

description_plain: When resigning employees from the biometric application, the employee's card ID must be surrendered. However, an error occurs during the process of surrendering the card ID.
comments:
1. The client reported that when they try to resign the employee from the employee master, the card ID does not surrender automatically. When they attempt to surrender the card ID manually, an AJAX error appears on the page.  
2. I requested remote access from the client, and after some time, they provided a Teams link, and I connected remotely.  
3. I then opened the employee master and attempted to surrender the card, but the same error occurred. Currently, the client’s system is running core version 66. After internal discussion, it was decided to update the core patches to resolve this issue. I uploaded the latest core version (90) to WeTransfer and shared the link with the client.  
4. The client downloaded the patches and placed them on the server. I then initiated the software patch update process, and after 20 minutes, the patch update was completed.  
5. I reopened the software and checked the card surrender process, but the same error appeared on the page.  
6. I discussed the matter with Milan Sir and checked the database. We found that the tag was showing as blank, which is why the error occurred when trying to surrender the card ID.  
7. We reviewed the case with multiple scenarios, identified the issue, and took some screenshots, which I attached to the ticket. I also requested the client to share the web log file and transferred the case to Level 2 support.
solution: we have upgrade the version and Sitecode column was missing in Empmaster table. As per remote session, after adding Sitecode, it’s working perfectly.

name: NetXsControl Ent.
ticket_title: issue while adding or editing any employee
description_plain: Facing issue while adding or editing any employee in the software
comments: Forward to Ketul.
solution:
We connected via remote access and reviewed the issue. 
Here’s a detailed :- 
1. Mismatch Between CardID and EmpID: 
We checked both the Netxs DB and ARS DB, and identified a mismatch between the CardID and EmpID. This mismatch was the reason the employee code was not displaying correctly.

 Resolution: After discussing with Sankar, it was decided to delete the employee record. Then, we used CardID and EmpID to identify the issue in NetxControl and re-added the card.
 2.New Employee Addition Error: An error occurred while adding a new employee. 

Resolution: After running the DDL statement and updating Netserver.DLL, the new employee was successfully added. 

3.Data Not Displaying After 7th February 2025: The data was not showing after 7th February 2025 because there were pending transactions in NetxControl. This is why the data was not being displayed. 

Resolution: We have now started the download process for the .exe file and all pending data has been successfully downloaded.

description_plain: Kindly look into below pending Query since long time. I was be late on 26th December 2024 by 13 minute and that is my 1st and last late mark of the month. I was not taking any other late mark on January month cycle. Even though in my attendance sheet it was reflected as halfday. Not able to delete late permission so need urgent support to delete it. employee id 137742
comments: We regret to inform you that we are unable to extend our support services in the absence of comprehensive AMC coverage. Please reach out to your Head Office HR team or GDSO for further clarity.
solution: 1. I opening the attendance sheet, we noticed that the shift information was incorrect. When attempting to apply for a shift change, a message indicated that late permission had already been approved for that day. 2. Despite trying to delete the late permission, the same message persisted. 3. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries: Select * from empmaster where code='137742' SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2024/12/26' AND category = 'Late'; Delete FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2024/12/26' AND category = 'Late'; 4.After removing the late permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to change the shift. To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode: Select * from attdmain where empid='' and attddate='2024/12/26' 5. With this adjustment, the employee was able to change the shift as needed.

description_plain: This is to inform you that duplicate passes have been created on the VMS (Visitor Management System). Please find the screenshot attached herewith for your reference
comments: We regret to inform you that we are unable to extend our support services in the absence of comprehensive AMC coverage. Please reach out to your Head Office HR team or GDSO for further clarity.
solution:
1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 200 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID. 
2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from Sept. 1, 2024, to Dec, 2024, and found more than 500 duplicate entries for all Zydus locations.
3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: Select * into Visitor_18122024 from Visitor 
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: 
Select * from Location 
Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='22' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: 
Delete from Visitor where id='666167' 
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.

description_plain: As discussed, we are experiencing a major technical issue with the attendance reader at the LIVA site. Additionally, punches from the past 20-25 days have not been downloaded. We request your urgent support to resolve this matter.
comments: We regret to inform you that we are unable to extend our support services in the absence of comprehensive AMC coverage. Please reach out to your Head Office HR team or GDSO for further clarity.
solution:
1. The client reported that NetXS downloading was not functioning, resulting in attendance data not being downloaded for the past month.
2. I requested remote access to investigate the issue.
3. Upon connecting remotely, I attempted to initiate the download within the software, but it failed to start and stopped automatically.
4. I examined the SQL database and discovered that it had reached its maximum size limit, which was preventing data downloads.
5. To resolve this, I archived old data within the software and waited for the process to complete.
6. After archiving, data downloading resumed normal operation.

name: iApp
description_plain: Please delete duplicate gate pass entries of V-89 Ravindra at Liva site.
comments: We regret to inform you that we are unable to extend our support services in the absence of comprehensive AMC coverage. Please reach out to your Head Office HR team or GDSO for further clarity.
solution:
1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 200 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID. 
2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from Sept. 1, 2024, to feb, 2025, and found more than 500 duplicate entries for all Zydus locations. 
3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: 
Select * into Visitor_04032025 from Visitor 
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: 
Select * from Location 
Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='22' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: 
Delete from Visitor where id='666167' 
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu

description_plain: Request you to do the needful as below error observed while accessing the software. Please treat this urgent.
comments:
1. The client reported that the iApp is not working and, when they try to open the iApp, an "ASP.NET Core Runtime" error appears on the page.
2. I requested remote access to check the issue from my side as well.
3. After some time, the client provided remote access, and I connected to the remote system. I opened the iApp, but the same error appeared.
4. I asked the client to share the server remote access because I needed to restart the IIS server process. The client then gave me the server remote access.
5. First, I stopped the Spectra worker process, restarted the IIS server process, and then started the Spectra worker process again. After opening the iApp, the same error was still showing on the page.
6. I discussed with the client and found that a Windows update had been applied two days ago, and since then, the software hasn’t been working. I opened the control panel, went to the IIS server and Windows features, and edited the features. I found that many checkboxes were not selected.
7. I enabled all the IIS features and started the process. After some time, the error "0X80072ee2" appeared. I checked and found that this error is related to IIS features.
8. I requested the client to restart the server and then check again. The IT team restarted the server, and I enabled the IIS features once more, but the same issue persisted. I advised them to connect with their Zydus IT team to enable the IIS features properly.
9. I also guided them on SSL certificates, advising them to check if the certificate was imported. If not, they should go to Google settings and import the SSL certificate.
solution:
1. We connected via remote access, and with admin rights, I tried to install IIS features, which was successfully completed.  
2. After that, I reinstalled the .NET server hosting and runtime files and waited for the process to complete.  
3. Once the process was completed, I tried to open the software, but an HTTP localhost error appeared on the web page.  
4. I discussed this matter with Setul Sir, checked the web, and found that the web was disabled. I enabled it, and then we restarted the IIS server.  
5. Now, the IAPP software is working fine. I checked both server login and user login, and everything is functioning as expected. The concern has been resolved.

comments:

We also requested the user to log in with administrative privileges to check if data was stored in the virtual box under the admin account. Despite this, the transaction data was still not visible.

After verifying all necessary settings and providing full administrative rights to the application folder, the live data still did not appear in the transactions. Given these findings, we recommend escalating this issue to the development team for further investigation and resolution.

ticket_title: Proper attendance has not been updated for the last 9 months.
description_plain: Proper attendance has not been updated for the last 9 months. We have requested to set the attendance policy same as ARS win but it's pending.
comments: We called the user, and they will call us back in 5 minutes.
solution: We called the user and connected via a remote session. The user mentioned that, for the last 9 months, employee attendance data has not been showing correctly. To investigate further, we asked the user to provide an example where the punch was correct, but the attendance record showed incorrect data. The user referred to the following example: The user punched IN on the IN device and then punched OUT on the OUT device. However, the system took the second OUT punch because the IN and OUT devices were configured separately in the Device Management. Upon checking the attendance policy, we found it was configured based on Swipe Movement, which is correct. We did not find any records that seemed to be incorrect. We kindly request you to guide employees to punch on the correct device: the IN punch should be on the IN device, and the OUT punch should be on the OUT device. If employees do their first punch on the OUT device, it will not calculate accurate attendance.

name: ARSWin-Net
description_plain: Dear Team, We have replaced one damage device in our office but unable to configure in the software, please assist on the same. Thanks &
comments: Email has been sent to client for ticket generation.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and discovered that the user is having issues with devices at IPs 192.168.3.211 and 192.168.3.34, where both devices were showing as offline.

To rectify this, we pinged the device at IP 192.168.3.34, which responded successfully from the server. Next, we opened the bootloader and confirmed that all the details configured in the software were correct. We reviewed the device firmware and updated it to CPU1XSControl_V419. After updating to the latest firmware, the device came online. However, the user mentioned they were unable to punch on the device. We then dumped the PC data to the reader, and after that, the user was able to punch on the device.

For the device at IP 192.168.3.211, we attempted to ping the IP, but it was not responding. We asked the user to check the device IP from the settings, but they didn’t know the password. We then asked the user to connect the device to a laptop via LAN cable. Once connected, we opened the bootloader and found the device, but the IP was incorrect. We tried changing the device IP, but it showed an error.

We then sought help from the IT team and updated the device IP, Subnet Mask, and Gateway IP. After entering the correct details, the device came online. We then dumped the user data, and the user was able to punch on the device.

comments: As discussed over a call user will connect us after 5 Minutes.
solution: We took a remote session with the user and found that one of the employees from the WC location was unable to view the attendance sheet from January 3rd. We checked all the required parameters and also changed the shift pattern to rectify the issue, but were unable to find a resolution. After that, we reprocessed the records, and now the data is showing correctly.

description_plain: Biomini installation on urgent basis.
comments:

7. After installation is completed service is not start so i reinstall the service setup and paste all the files to the program files folder. 
8. Now biomini is working properly.

description_plain: As discussed, request you to please resolve OT error (Pending At System) in the system.
comments:
1. The client reported that although the overtime hierarchy final approval has been changed, the overtime applications are still showing as pending in the system. 
2. To address this issue, I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query to clear all pending OT applications: 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply (nolock) WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1 AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-11-26' AND '2025-02-10' 
UPDATE adjustapply SET f7 = NULL WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1 AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-11-26' AND '2025-02-10' 
3. After executing the update and allowing some time for processing, all the OT applications were successfully cleared. 4. Now Pending OT has been cleared and OT is showing pending at respective approval.

ticket_title: Guidance Needed on Deleting Resigned Employee Records in Spectra
description_plain: Dear Spectra Team, We would like to understand how to delete the records of resigned employees in Spectra without impacting their attendance details. Additionally, we would appreciate a step-by-step guide for HR purposes on how to remove these entries. We have some employees who resigned from Amrita Hospital and joined SEPL Company, resulting in their registration in Spectra twice, thus consuming two licenses. We would like to remove these duplicate entries from Spectra. Moreover, all new joiners are currently waiting for HR to complete their registration process. Kindly treat this matter as urgent, and we look forward to your prompt assistance. Thanks & Regards, Sandeep Kumar M-: 7827222249 Dept -: IT & Digital Infrastructure Mata Amritanandamayi Marg, Sector - 88 Haryana (Pin 121002) Amrita University
comments:
Dear Sir,


As per our discussion, we have checked and found that your license limit has been reached. To reduce the license count, you need to relieve all employees who have resigned. This will help decrease your license usage.


Process to Reduce License Count for Resigned Employees

    > Select a Resigned Employee
          Choose any one resigned employee from the list.
          Note down their resignation date and leaving date.

    > Rejoin the Employee
         Rejoin the selected resigned employee in the system.

    >Resign the Employee Again
         After rejoining, go to the employee master.
         Select the same employee and mark them as resigned again.
         Enter the resignation date and leaving date
        
After completing this process, the license count will decrease automatically within some time.
This method has been tested live and has worked successfully.

If you face any issues during this process, please inform me.

description_plain: We have faced the issue of biometrics; we are unable to add the new user. I have attached screenshots for your reference
comments:
As discussed this morning, I have some pre-assigned tasks, so I am unable to connect with you right now.

solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that the device status for the Jigani location was continuously showing as 'Waiting.'

To resolve this, we accessed the database server and performed the following queries:

Select * from ControllerMaster where ipaddr='10.41.0.5'
Select * from Machinedata where ControllerID='32' and Status='P'
Select * into Machinedata_1302205 from Machinedata
Delete from Machinedata where ControllerID='32' and Status='P'

name: NetXsControl Ent.
description_plain: Netxscontrol reader configured but access is not working.
comments:
1. I connected to the client via remote access, opened the software, went to the controller utility menu, and checked the status of both devices. I found that the exit device was showing as inactive.
2. I opened CMD and tried to ping the device IP, but it wasn't working.
3. I requested the client to check whether the device was working, so they sent someone to the device location. It was found that the device was not working and was powered off.
4. I guided them on how to power on the device so we could check it, but for some reason, the client was unable to power it on at that moment. They requested that we reconnect tomorrow to investigate further.
solution:
1. I connected to the client via remote access and found that the exit device is now showing as active properly.  
2. I went to the controller utility and dumped the data into the exit controller.  
3. After that, I went to the card format and set the card format for the device.  
4. I suggested that someone punch on both the entry and exit devices. One employee punched in the device where access was already assigned, and on the Bioscribe 2C device, the card punch is working. However, on the Biostamp 2C device, a fingerprint was needed for punching.  
5. We took the employee’s finger, and I guided them on how to register the fingerprint in the software, how to place the finger on the device, and how to save the data.  
6. After that, I suggested they punch on the device, and now the entry and exit punches are working fine for both devices for that employee.  
7. We then added multiple employees and repeated the same process. After punching, no issues were found. I guided them through the process, and all employee fingerprint access is working fine now.  
8. I also guided them on how to start Netxsdonwloading, how to select the controller, and how to begin the downloading process.  
9. Now, the software is working fine.

description_plain: Repaired device configuration in software
comments:
We took a remote session with the user and found that the user had installed and configured the repaired device into the ARS Win software. The issue was that the user was able to punch on the device, but the data was not downloading.

To investigate, we asked the user to punch on the device while we stopped the downloading executable. After the employee punched, we found pending transactions in the reader utility, and we started the downloading executable. The transaction count became 0, but the data still did not show.

We concluded that the downloading might be running on another system, but the user mentioned that there was no other system with the software installed, and this was the only server system where the software was installed.

To resolve the issue, we asked for a free IP and assigned a new IP to the device, so if data was downloading somewhere else due to the previous IP, it would no longer download there. After making this change, we also updated the device's IP and asked the user to punch on the device and start the downloading process, but the data still did not appear, although the transaction count became 0.

For further investigation, we accessed the database and took one employee for testing. We asked the employee to punch on the device, and in the database, we found that the card ID did not match the employee's card ID in the Employee Master.

We then copied the card ID from the database and updated the Employee Master with the correct card ID. After this, we asked the user to punch on the device again, and the data was visible in both the downloading utility and the spreadsheet, as confirmed by the client

ticket_title: Ongoing Punch-In Issues at Multiple Branches
description_plain: Ongoing Punch-In Issues at Multiple Branches
comments:
As we connected remotely, we discussed and resolved some of your queries regarding the iApp software.
1. Upload Bulk Employee Data in Employee Master

Spectra Comments:
We found that you were trying to add bulk employee data through the Import Database module and encountered issues while validating the data.
As we suggested, the error records need to be rectified. Once the validation is successful, you can save the data.
2. Assign Access Group to All Newly Added Employees

Spectra Comments:
As we suggested, after adding any new employee, an access group must be assigned so that the employee can punch in at the door.
Please refer to the steps below to assign access:
iApp > Attendance Management > Assignment > Assign Access
Here, you will find all the newly added employees who do not have an access group (marked under "Unassigned" status).
Select the employee and then assign either Local Access (for the current location door access rights) or Global Access (for access at another location).

As we observed, some commands are pending for certain doors due to the device being offline.
If a command did not pass to the device, the employee will not be able to punch in.
3. Assign Attendance Policy to New Employees

Spectra Comments:
As we suggested, after adding any new employee, an attendance policy needs to be assigned so that their punch data reflects correctly in the spreadsheet as per the policy.
To assign an attendance policy in bulk, please follow the steps below:
iApp > Attendance Management > Assignment > Policy Mapping
Select employees, then click Assign Policy, select the relevant policy, and save.
4. Employees Are Unable to Punch on the Device at Different Locations

Spectra Comments:
After assigning the access group and attendance policy to employees, we verified with some of the employees and confirmed they were able to punch successfully on the device.
However, some employees were unable to punch on the device, and we discovered that their fingerprints were not registered.
If any employee is unable to punch, please check if their fingerprint is registered. If not, please proceed with registration.
5. Bhima Employee Active Employee Count and Spectra Active Employee Count Are Not Matching

Spectra Comments:
While importing data for 300 employees into Spectra, we encountered a "License Full" error.
We checked the license summary, and you currently have 2,300 licenses, of which 2,264 are in use.
We also reviewed the Active Employee Count in the Employee Master (excluding Bhima Home & Corporate office), which is 2,106. However, the actual active count across all employees is 2,370, which does not match our observations.
As per your  attached database, the active employee count is 2,103.
solution:
As we connected, we found that the Spectra license count does not match the database as per your observations.

We studied the files you provided and identified that the active employee count in the Employee Master is showing 2,370, while the License Summary shows 2,264. You currently have a license for 2,300 users, which means you can add 36 more employees.

In the iApp application, the license count is determined based on the attendance policy and access group assigned to employees.

We also checked the database and confirmed that the employee count matches the license summary. We performed a VLOOKUP across all three files and found that some employees are listed in your sheet but not in the License Summary, and vice versa.

In conclusion, there are 2,370 active employees, of which 2,264 have a policy assigned. The remaining active employees can be relieved to create space.

However, as you mentioned that there are many employees that need to be uploaded into the system, you will need to procure a new license, as we confirmed.
