description_plain: Finger not found for lots of employee in QC micro area
comments:
1. The client reported that the fingerprint was not found for many employees in the QC micro lab.  
2. I guided them to provide me with the list of employees so I could check from my side as well.  
3. After receiving the list, I opened the employee master and found that the fingerprints were showing correctly.  
4. I went to the "Get Finger" option, fetched the fingerprints, and both fingerprints were displaying correctly.  
5. I then went to the "Assign Access" menu and reassigned the access to the employees. The command was successfully processed.  
6. I repeated the same process for multiple employees, checked the fingerprint access on the device, and now access is working fine.

ticket_title: InTime and Outtime not working for some users
description_plain: Dear Gaurang, In cuddalore location, we face issue for some of the users that his InTime and Outtime is not working in Face Reader, it gives the Stranger error again and again. Now this issue comes in regular basis and users attendance is affecting. Please give me your availability to resolve this issue.
comments: we will connect after 3 o'clock .
solution:
Hello Sir,

9170705 Employee Problem: This issue occurred due to the maximum shift hours being exceeded. I recommend adding the employee details manually to resolve the issue.

As discussed, we used the IP address, subnet mask, and gateway of a working device and entered them into the non-pinging device. After the change, the device started responding, indicating an issue with the IP address. If the device still doesn’t ping after the changes, it likely has an internal issue.

5. I proceeded to the Attendance Policy and created a new attendance policy with working hours set from the shift start to the shift end, totaling 01:00 hour.  
6. After completing the setup, I guided the client to assign the attendance policy and shift pattern policy to the relevant employees.

description_plain: The turnstile is not working and is rotating automatically without any punch. Kindly address this issue on an urgent basis as it is required for the audit.
comments:
1. The client reported that one turnstile device is not working, showing offline and displaying a 200 error on the device.  
2. I opened the database menu in the software and found the device marked as inactive, so I accessed the Zydus server and checked the device IP, which was found to be active.  
3. I opened the bootloader application, searched for the device, and found it. I then proceeded to update the firmware of the device.  
4. After the firmware update was completed, the device showed as active for a minute, but the same error reappeared on the device display.  
5. I identified a hardware-related fingerprint issue, so I guided them to send the device back to the Spectra service center for repair.  
6. All other turnstiles were unlocked and free to access at any time. I discussed this matter with Jatin Sir and checked the door open time, which showed 1 second (which was correct). I then checked the device mode and updated the arm mode of the device.  
7. After that, the same issue persisted, so I requested them to send a video to help us understand the actual issue.  
8. After waiting for some time, the client sent the video. I reviewed the video with Jatin Sir and identified that the issue was related to the turnstile power.  
9. I guided the client to check the power connection of the turnstile. The client confirmed that they had checked the power connection with the engineering team and would update us accordingly.

name: iApp
description_plain: Emp No. 364852 - Yuvrajsinh Chavda is not able to login his SPECTRA. While login, password was also reset - Welcome@01, still not able to login.
comments:
We have thoroughly checked and verified all details, including integration logs, active/inactive cases, the relieved process, and the rejoining process.

During our code review, we identified an issue in the employee rejoining process. When the system updates the status to "Active" in the allusers and usermaster tables, the update was not executed within the same database transaction. As a result, if an error occurred during the process, the status in the allusers table would be set to "Active," but the status in the usermaster table would still remain as 'D'. This inconsistency prevented the employee from logging in.

To resolve this issue, we have implemented a transaction to ensure that the entire process runs within a single atomic operation.
solution: The ticket is considered closed for now.

description_plain: Dear Team, As per attached print screen, pending attendance regularization applications are not showing with the reporting managers. Please check & resolve issue as soon as possible.
comments:
Duplicate Ticket :- TKT044154
During a remote session, we reviewed the system audit logs and identified that the HR team had set certain employee codes to NULL. As a result, whenever an update was processed through the AD file, the system incorrectly assigned a primary manager to employees with NULL employee codes.

To address this issue, we provided the necessary queries to help the client identify and update the affected records in the database.

Permanent Solution: Implementing a Script to Prevent NULL Employee Codes
As a part of the permanent resolution, we have developed a script that ensures employee codes are never set to NULL. 

Queries Provided to the Client

The following queries were provided to retrieve records from the relevant tables:

select * from eams.empmaster where id = '';
select * from eams.allusers where id = ''
select * from empmanagers where managerid = ''
update eams.allusers set empcode = ''where and id = '';
update eams.empmaster set code = '' where id = '';
update eams.empmanagers set managerid = null where managerid = ;


Please take backup of adjustapply table as per below query.
----------------------------------------------
select ad.* from adjustapply ad
inner join empmanagers emp on ad.companyid=emp.companyid and ad.userid=emp.empid
where ad.sendappto='' and ad.laststatus in ('U','C','CPU') and emp.alternatemanagers is not null
order by ad.companyid,ad.userid

execte below query to select affected records
-----------------------------------------------------------
select ad.id,ad.companyid,emp.companyid,ad.userid,emp.empid,ad.sendappto,emp.alternatemanagers from adjustapply ad
inner join empmanagers emp on ad.companyid=emp.companyid and ad.userid=emp.empid
where ad.sendappto='' and ad.laststatus in ('U','C','CPU') and emp.alternatemanagers is not null
order by ad.companyid,ad.userid

-------------execute below query to update sendappto column in adjustapply for effected employees-----------------
UPDATE adjustapply ad
SET ad.sendappto = (
    SELECT emp.alternatemanagers 
    FROM empmanagers emp
    WHERE ad.companyid = emp.companyid
    AND ad.userid = emp.empid
    AND emp.alternatemanagers is not null
)
WHERE ad.sendappto = ''
AND ad.laststatus IN ('U', 'C', 'CPU')

description_plain: They are not able to relive any employee with existing date, if any punch / transaction is found.
comments:
We explained them that this feature has been introduced in the current version to ensure that no transactions exist beyond the relieving date. This helps prevent incorrect mapping of the relieving date, which could lead to discrepancies if the employee has already recorded punches after the intended date.

To resolve this, you may relieve the employee on the next day of the actual relieving date while ensuring that the effective relieving date remains unchanged. For example, if an employee's relieving date is 15/02/2025 and a punch is recorded for the same day, you will need to relieve them on 16/02/2025 or later, with the effective relieving date still set as 15/02/2025.

ticket_title: Issue in Moraiya D2 VIP Punching machine -(Food Punching machine)
description_plain: Hello Team, Issue coming from last 2 days in Moraiya D2 VIP Canteen (Food punching machine) “No user found”. Checked with IT team also, There is no issue of network. Kindly check and resolve the issue Thanks &
comments: We regret to inform you that we are unable to extend our support services in the absence of comprehensive AMC coverage. Please reach out to your Head Office HR team or GDSO for further clarity.
solution:
1. The client reported a **"Printer Disconnected"** error when punching on the device. I guided them to go to **Network Parameters** and select the **Print Slip Configuration**.  
2. They **disabled the print slip** and tried punching again, but then encountered a **"Card Format Error"**.  
3. I instructed them to go to **System Settings**, select the **Card Format**, and choose the **Clock Data Format**.  
4. Now, **canteen punching is working fine**, and I also performed the **user dump activity**.

description_plain: We have received the devises and Two devise has been installed also But devise punching data not showing in punch details. So, look into this. 1.Trunstile2 -out:172.24.115.13 2.Trunstile5 -out:172.24.115.11
comments:
1. After the repair was completed, the device was received by the client, and they need to configure it.
2. I requested the client to share the IP addresses of both devices they received. Once the client shared the IP confirmation, I attempted to connect to the Zydus server, but the account was blocked. I cleared the Chrome history and tried again, but the same issue persisted.
3. I made multiple attempts to connect, and then reached out to the Zydus HO team via email, informing them that we were unable to connect to the Zydus server and needed to configure the devices.
4. I connected with the Zydus HO IT team, shared the details and screenshots, and waited for a response, but the same issue continued.

solution:
1. The IT team has resolved the server-related issue, and I have connected to the Zydus server.  
2. I checked both device IP addresses, and both devices are showing as active on the server. I then opened the bootloader application and updated the firmware of both devices.  
3. After that, I opened the software, and now both devices are showing as active in the database menu, but the users are not displaying correctly.  
4. I performed a factory reset on both devices one by one, edited and saved the device settings, and the commands are now being executed successfully.  
5. I set the card format for both devices and started the user dump process on each device.  
6. I waited for a while to complete the user dump process for both devices.  
7. The dump process is now complete, and both devices are working fine.

ticket_title: Canteen Management System Issue - Incorrect Date Display
description_plain: Dear Concern, Our canteen system is currently down due to an incorrect date display issue. Both the device and software are showing a backdated date. For your reference, please find the screenshot attached. Requesting your immediate assistance to resolve this issue Thanks &
comments: Email has been sent to client for ticket generation.
solution: Remotely, there was an issue with the Date & Time in the Canteen Management software. We checked manually, but an "Invalid parameter" error was occurring. The software version was outdated, so we found the file first on our personal system and then placed 3 files on the client's desktop (Canteen.exe, CanteenDownloading.exe, and CanteenReader.dll). We placed the CanteenReader.dll in the SysWow folder and registered it. The other two executables were placed in the software folder with new names, as the old executables had their names changed. Then, we closed and restarted the software, refreshed it, and checked the Date & Time process for the reader. It has now been successfully completed. Closed.

comments: Email has been sent to client for ticket generation.
solution: Remotely, there was an issue with the Date & Time in the Canteen Management software. We checked manually, but an "Invalid parameter" error was occurring. The software version was outdated, so we found the file first on our personal system and then placed 3 files on the client's desktop (Canteen.exe, CanteenDownloading.exe, and CanteenReader.dll). We placed the CanteenReader.dll in the SysWow folder and registered it. The other two executables were placed in the software folder with new names, as the old executables had their names changed. Then, we closed and restarted the software, refreshed it, and checked the Date & Time process for the reader. It has now been successfully completed. Closed.

name: iApp
description_plain: Pls find trail mail and need to O.T transfer of Pending at system to actual O.T approver.
comments: We regret to inform you that we are unable to extend our support services in the absence of comprehensive AMC coverage. Please reach out to your Head Office HR team or GDSO for further clarity.
solution:
1. The client reported that although the overtime hierarchy final approval has been changed, the overtime applications are still showing as pending in the system. 
2. To address this issue, I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query to clear all pending OT applications: 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply (nolock) WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1 AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-11-26' AND '2025-02-10' 
UPDATE adjustapply SET f7 = NULL WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1 AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-11-26' AND '2025-02-10' 
3. After executing the update and allowing some time for processing, all the OT applications were successfully cleared. 
4. Now Pending OT has been cleared and OT is showing pending at respective approval.

description_plain: Below error show during open in time and attendance. Zydus Darwin box open but only time and attendance not open. Name of Employee: Patel Arvind Employee no: 150984
comments: We regret to inform you that we are unable to extend our support services in the absence of comprehensive AMC coverage. Please reach out to your Head Office HR team or GDSO for further clarity.
solution:
1. The client reported that when they try to log in with employee ID 150984, an error message appears stating, "User is not authorized for this page." 
2. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries to check if any filters were applied: `
SELECT * FROM UserMaster (nolock) WHERE empid='8870'` `
SELECT * FROM usersettings WHERE id='27' AND category LIKE '%filter%'` 
3. I then deleted the settings with the category 'FILTERING' where the ID was '27.' 
4. I did not find any filters, so I went to the user group, selected the web portal, searched for the employee, and did not find the employee ID. I then added the employee, inserted the user ID and password, and added them to the user group. 
4. The employee's login is now working properly.

name: BIOT
description_plain: Device configuration
comments: As discussed, the client is not available on the client’s side.
solution: After remotely accessing the system, I initiated the process by inputting the necessary router details, ensuring a seamless configuration process. This involved establishing a secure router ID password to safeguard the network from unauthorized access. Next, I carefully configured the Wi-Fi frequency to operate at 2.4 GHz, a common choice for its wider range coverage and compatibility with various devices. This step was crucial in optimizing the network performance for the client's specific needs. Subsequently, I guided the client through the steps required to connect to the newly configured Wi-Fi network using the designated biot application. This involved them through the application interface and assisting them in inputting the required information, such as the network name (SSID) and the secure password. Once the client successfully inputted the necessary details, the connection was established between their device and the Wi-Fi network. This ensured that they could seamlessly access the internet and other network resources without any disruptions. Furthermore, recognizing the importance of ensuring continuous connectivity, I provided clear instructions to the client on how to reconnect to the Wi-Fi network in case of any disconnection issues. This included troubleshooting steps such as restarting the device, checking for any interference, and verifying the Wi-Fi settings. By empowering the client with this knowledge, I aimed to minimize any potential downtime and ensure a smooth user experience with their newly configured Wi-Fi network. After that, when they punched on the device, it showed 'finger not available.' We synced the device and checked the live punch again. However, it then showed 'access denied.' We checked the user page and found that the issue was due to the device access not being assigned. We assigned the device access to the user and then checked the live punch again. This time, it showed 'access allowed,' and all punches were successfully reflected in the software. The issue has now been resolved.

ticket_title: All doors of Tower-C opened automatically
description_plain: This is to inform you that an incident related to the access control system has occurred, wherein all the entry gates of SBIC site in Tower-C, 10th Floor, 11th Floor, and 12th Floor opened automatically without any human intervention. Please look into this matter and take necessary action. Please share the RCA with us after investigation regarding this issue. Date of incident:- 18-Feb'25. Time of incident:- 09:21AM to 09:23AM. Duration:- Approx 02 minutes.
comments: Forward to the L2
solution:
We have investigated the issue where all doors were opening even during minor fire executions. Below is the RCA along with the corrective and preventive actions taken.

Issue Summary:
During a recent incident, all doors were found to be opening even during minor fire executions. Upon investigation, we identified that the fire time configuration in the device was set to 100 milliseconds, causing immediate door release upon fire signal activation.

RCA :
The fire time setting was configured to 100 milliseconds, which resulted in all doors opening instantly, even for minor fire triggers. This setting led to unintended door releases, impacting access control functionality.
Corrective Action Taken:

    The fire time setting has been updated from 100 milliseconds to 2000 milliseconds in the device configuration.
    With this update, doors will now release 2 seconds after a fire execution, ensuring better control and preventing unintended unlocking.

To address this issue, we provided the necessary queries to help the client identify and update the affected records in the database.

Permanent Solution: Implementing a Script to Prevent NULL Employee Codes
As a part of the permanent resolution, we have developed a script that ensures employee codes are never set to NULL. 

Queries Provided to the Client

The following queries were provided to retrieve records from the relevant tables:

select * from eams.empmaster where id = '';
select * from eams.allusers where id = ''
select * from empmanagers where managerid = ''
update eams.allusers set empcode = ''where and id = '';
update eams.empmaster set code = '' where id = '';
update eams.empmanagers set managerid = null where managerid = ;


Please take backup of adjustapply table as per below query.
----------------------------------------------
select ad.* from adjustapply ad
inner join empmanagers emp on ad.companyid=emp.companyid and ad.userid=emp.empid
where ad.sendappto='' and ad.laststatus in ('U','C','CPU') and emp.alternatemanagers is not null
order by ad.companyid,ad.userid

execte below query to select affected records
-----------------------------------------------------------
select ad.id,ad.companyid,emp.companyid,ad.userid,emp.empid,ad.sendappto,emp.alternatemanagers from adjustapply ad
inner join empmanagers emp on ad.companyid=emp.companyid and ad.userid=emp.empid
where ad.sendappto='' and ad.laststatus in ('U','C','CPU') and emp.alternatemanagers is not null
order by ad.companyid,ad.userid

UPDATE adjustapply ad
SET ad.sendappto = (
    SELECT emp.alternatemanagers 
    FROM empmanagers emp
    WHERE ad.companyid = emp.companyid
    AND ad.userid = emp.empid
    AND emp.alternatemanagers is not null
)
WHERE ad.sendappto = ''
AND ad.laststatus IN ('U', 'C', 'CPU')

comments:
Duplicate Ticket :- TKT044154
During a remote session, we reviewed the system audit logs and identified that the HR team had set certain employee codes to NULL. As a result, whenever an update was processed through the AD file, the system incorrectly assigned a primary manager to employees with NULL employee codes.

To address this issue, we provided the necessary queries to help the client identify and update the affected records in the database.

Permanent Solution: Implementing a Script to Prevent NULL Employee Codes
As a part of the permanent resolution, we have developed a script that ensures employee codes are never set to NULL. 

Queries Provided to the Client

The following queries were provided to retrieve records from the relevant tables:

select * from eams.empmaster where id = '';
select * from eams.allusers where id = ''
select * from empmanagers where managerid = ''
update eams.allusers set empcode = ''where and id = '';
update eams.empmaster set code = '' where id = '';
update eams.empmanagers set managerid = null where managerid = ;


Please take backup of adjustapply table as per below query.
----------------------------------------------
select ad.* from adjustapply ad
inner join empmanagers emp on ad.companyid=emp.companyid and ad.userid=emp.empid
where ad.sendappto='' and ad.laststatus in ('U','C','CPU') and emp.alternatemanagers is not null
order by ad.companyid,ad.userid

execte below query to select affected records
-----------------------------------------------------------
select ad.id,ad.companyid,emp.companyid,ad.userid,emp.empid,ad.sendappto,emp.alternatemanagers from adjustapply ad
inner join empmanagers emp on ad.companyid=emp.companyid and ad.userid=emp.empid
where ad.sendappto='' and ad.laststatus in ('U','C','CPU') and emp.alternatemanagers is not null
order by ad.companyid,ad.userid

-------------execute below query to update sendappto column in adjustapply for effected employees-----------------
UPDATE adjustapply ad
SET ad.sendappto = (
    SELECT emp.alternatemanagers 
    FROM empmanagers emp
    WHERE ad.companyid = emp.companyid
    AND ad.userid = emp.empid
    AND emp.alternatemanagers is not null
)
WHERE ad.sendappto = ''
AND ad.laststatus IN ('U', 'C', 'CPU')

During a remote session, we reviewed the system audit logs and identified that the HR team had set certain employee codes to NULL. As a result, whenever an update was processed through the AD file, the system incorrectly assigned a primary manager to employees with NULL employee codes.

To address this issue, we provided the necessary queries to help the client identify and update the affected records in the database.

Permanent Solution: Implementing a Script to Prevent NULL Employee Codes
As a part of the permanent resolution, we have developed a script that ensures employee codes are never set to NULL. 

Queries Provided to the Client

The following queries were provided to retrieve records from the relevant tables:

select * from eams.empmaster where id = '';
select * from eams.allusers where id = ''
select * from empmanagers where managerid = ''
update eams.allusers set empcode = ''where and id = '';
update eams.empmaster set code = '' where id = '';
update eams.empmanagers set managerid = null where managerid = ;


Please take backup of adjustapply table as per below query.
----------------------------------------------
select ad.* from adjustapply ad
inner join empmanagers emp on ad.companyid=emp.companyid and ad.userid=emp.empid
where ad.sendappto='' and ad.laststatus in ('U','C','CPU') and emp.alternatemanagers is not null
order by ad.companyid,ad.userid

execte below query to select affected records
-----------------------------------------------------------
select ad.id,ad.companyid,emp.companyid,ad.userid,emp.empid,ad.sendappto,emp.alternatemanagers from adjustapply ad
inner join empmanagers emp on ad.companyid=emp.companyid and ad.userid=emp.empid
where ad.sendappto='' and ad.laststatus in ('U','C','CPU') and emp.alternatemanagers is not null
order by ad.companyid,ad.userid

-------------execute below query to update sendappto column in adjustapply for effected employees-----------------
UPDATE adjustapply ad
SET ad.sendappto = (
    SELECT emp.alternatemanagers 
    FROM empmanagers emp
    WHERE ad.companyid = emp.companyid
    AND ad.userid = emp.empid
    AND emp.alternatemanagers is not null
)
WHERE ad.sendappto = ''
AND ad.laststatus IN ('U', 'C', 'CPU')

   ```sql
   Select * from attdmain (Nolock) where empid='' and attddate=''
   ```
5. I deleted all the attendance data for the specified dates one by one using the query:
   ```sql
   Delete from attdmain where empid='' and attddate=''
   ```
6. After that, I reprocessed the attendance, and now the attendance data is showing correctly from the date of 10/02/2025.

During a remote session, we reviewed the system audit logs and identified that the HR team had set certain employee codes to NULL. As a result, whenever an update was processed through the AD file, the system incorrectly assigned a primary manager to employees with NULL employee codes.

Permanent Solution: Implementing a Script to Prevent NULL Employee Codes
As a part of the permanent resolution, we have developed a script that ensures employee codes are never set to NULL. 

Queries Provided to the Client

The following queries were provided to retrieve records from the relevant tables:

select * from eams.empmaster where id = '';
select * from eams.allusers where id = ''
select * from empmanagers where managerid = ''
update eams.allusers set empcode = ''where and id = '';
update eams.empmaster set code = '' where id = '';
update eams.empmanagers set managerid = null where managerid = ;


Please take backup of adjustapply table as per below query.
----------------------------------------------
select ad.* from adjustapply ad
inner join empmanagers emp on ad.companyid=emp.companyid and ad.userid=emp.empid
where ad.sendappto='' and ad.laststatus in ('U','C','CPU') and emp.alternatemanagers is not null
order by ad.companyid,ad.userid

execte below query to select affected records
-----------------------------------------------------------
select ad.id,ad.companyid,emp.companyid,ad.userid,emp.empid,ad.sendappto,emp.alternatemanagers from adjustapply ad
inner join empmanagers emp on ad.companyid=emp.companyid and ad.userid=emp.empid
where ad.sendappto='' and ad.laststatus in ('U','C','CPU') and emp.alternatemanagers is not null
order by ad.companyid,ad.userid

-------------execute below query to update sendappto column in adjustapply for effected employees-----------------
UPDATE adjustapply ad
SET ad.sendappto = (
    SELECT emp.alternatemanagers 
    FROM empmanagers emp
    WHERE ad.companyid = emp.companyid
    AND ad.userid = emp.empid
    AND emp.alternatemanagers is not null
)
WHERE ad.sendappto = ''
AND ad.laststatus IN ('U', 'C', 'CPU')

description_plain: Employee iapp login is not working and showing error when open the time and attendance.
comments:
1. The client reported that the iApp login is not working for employee ID 152032.
2. I requested them to share the employee login credentials so I could check from my side as well.

5. I did not find any employee with that employee ID, so I went to the software and opened the web portal.
6. I searched for the employee but could not find them, so I added the user in the web portal and saved the details.
7. After that, I reopened the user login, and the iApp opened correctly.
solution:

3. After waiting for some time, the client shared the credentials, and I logged in, finding an error stating that the user is not authorized.
4. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query in the database:  
   `SELECT * FROM usermaster WHERE id='';`  
   `SELECT * FROM usergroup WHERE id='';`
5. I did not find any employee with that employee ID, so I went to the software and opened the web portal.

name: iApp
description_plain: Hi, We need to update iApp as per attached policy. Balance CL of 2024 to be uploaded in PL in the year 2025. Please help.
comments: We have called the user, but they are not reachable at the moment.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that they wanted to make some changes to the attendance and leave policy. To address this, we discussed and resolved the points mentioned below:

Coff Policy Change
Spectra Comments: As we reviewed the current Coff policy, we found that if any employee worked for 6 hours, they were eligible to apply for Coff. However, as per the user's requirement, if any employee works for 5 hours and 35 minutes, they should be allowed to apply for Coff. To accommodate this, we have edited the Coff policy and added 335 minutes in the script.

Remove Prefix & Fix Sandwich Rule
Spectra Comments: The user mentioned that according to their new policy, the sandwich rule should no longer apply to any employee. Therefore, we have removed the sandwich rule for all types of leave.

Attendance Policy Work Hours Change
Spectra Comments: Upon reviewing the current attendance policy, we found that if an employee works for 4 hours and 35 minutes, it is considered a full day of attendance. However, as per the user’s current policy, if any employee works for 3 hours and 35 minutes, it should be considered a full day of attendance. This change has been implemented accordingly.

Leave Policy Change for CL, PL, & SL
Spectra Comments: As per the current leave policy, all leave types were given on a yearly basis. However, as per the user’s requirement, PL, SL, and CL should be given on a monthly basis. To accommodate this, we have changed the leave type from yearly to monthly and also set the opening balance as required. After modifying the leave policy, we also guided the user through the leave accrual process.

description_plain: Dear Mrigankbhai, We have been facing recurring issues with payroll at the end of every month, and support only starts at 12:00 noon. name: iApp
description_plain: Attendance data not showing for the date of 25/02/2025 so do the needful on urgent basis.
comments:
1. The client reported that data for 25th Feb. and 26th Feb. is not showing for many employees across all Zydus locations.  
2. I checked this issue with the help of Setul Sir, but we did not find any pending data in the trans table.  
3. We checked the X flag data and failed data, and found a lot of missing data. Setul Sir then changed the status to "pending" in the database.  
4. The data is currently in the downloading stage and is downloading slowly. We checked with the following query and will wait for some time:

   ```sql
   Select * from Trans (Nolock) 
   where punchdetail between '2025-02-20 00:00:00' and '2025-02-26 23:00:00' 
   order by updateon desc
   ```
solution: 1. I connected with Mr. Dhaval and Mr. Sanjay from the product development team and shared the Zydus remote server details to assist in diagnosing and resolving the issue. 2. I informed them that the Spectra Worker Service restarts every 5 minutes, indicating a known bug. They created a new Spectra Worker Service and sent it to me. I then emailed Mr. Jignesh Prajapati from Zydus HO, requesting that he place this file on the Spectra server so I could replace the existing file. 3. After replacing the file and restarting the Spectra Worker process, the issue persisted. 4. The development team will re-examine the system to remove duplicate and unnecessary transactions from the device transactions. 5. After waiting for some time, transactions are now displaying correctly. We will monitor the system for one more day to ensure all pending transactions are cleared from the device.
